title: Senior Oracle EPM Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Job Title:</strong> <strong>Senior </strong><strong>Oracle EPM Specialist</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong> This critical role is responsible for ensuring smooth financial operations throughout the close cycles by maintaining the stability, security, and high performance of Oracle GL and Oracle EPM environments. The EPM Specialist will absorb knowledge transfer from implementation partners and serve as the primary operational lead for Financial Consolidation and Close - FCCS, Account Reconciliation - ARCS, Profitability and Cost Management - PCMCS, and Enterprise Data Management - EDMCS. A core aspect of the job involves collaborating cross-functionally with IT and business teams to understand downstream system impacts, manage critical system handshakes, and oversee regular maintenance. Partnering closely with Financial Systems leadership, you will help translate the strategic roadmap into reality. </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Cross-Functional System Execution:</strong> Work closely with finance, IT, and cross-functional teams to implement roadmap initiatives and evaluate downstream impacts.</li> <li><strong>Troubleshooting & Resolution:</strong> Investigate and resolve data load, mapping, validation, and calculation issues. Track and resolve recurring or critical issues through Oracle Service Requests</li> <li><strong>Financial Module Ownership:</strong> Define and own the functional configuration roadmap for key financial modules, including General Ledger<strong>.</strong></li> <li><strong>Compliance and System Configuration:</strong> Directly design and configure Oracle Fusion to ensure enforcement of critical financial compliance standards (e.g., ASC 606/IFRS 15, SOX).</li> <li><strong>Data Integration Management:</strong> Administer Data Exchange pipelines, import/export definitions, and update EDM subscriptions to keep metadata aligned. Manage calculation rules, consolidations, and cash flow mappings.</li> <li><strong>Maintenance & Patching:</strong> Review release notes and perform patch regression testing on monthly EPM patches, promoting updates safely across DEV, TEST, and PROD pods.</li> <li><strong>System Support & Operations:</strong> Manage and monitor user access control, including assigning predefined and application roles. Provide functional support during close cycles, assisting users with application navigation, workflows, and Smart View queries.</li> <li><strong>PCMCS & Profitability Management:</strong> Maintain and configure Profitability and Cost Management (PCMCS) applications, managing allocation rules, cost assignment logic, and data model builds.</li> <li><strong>Solution Architecture & Development:</strong> Partner with leadership to design, build, and optimize scalable EPM data models and solutions. Translate business requirements into technical architecture and execute complex development work across FCCS, ARCS, PCMCS and EDMCS.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Active Oracle Cloud EPM Certification(s)</strong> (e.g., Financial Consolidation and Close (FCCS), Account Reconciliation (ARCS), Enterprise Data Management (EDMCS), Profitability and Cost Management (PCMCS) or EPM Data Integration).</li> <li>Strong hands-on experience managing and supporting core Oracle Cloud EPM modules, specifically FCCS, ARCS, EDMCS, and PCMCS.</li> <li>Proven ability to manage daily operations, including integrations, consolidations, and reconciliations.</li> <li>Exceptional troubleshooting skills, specifically regarding Smart View installations, connection settings, and resolving setup conflicts.</li> <li>Experience managing user security, access roles, and maintaining compliance governance.</li> <li>Ability to perform monthly/quarterly close operations and execute environment health checks.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with cross-functional IT and business teams to evaluate inbound and outbound data flows and build architectural solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).</li> <li>Familiarity or experience with Oracle Tax Reporting (TRCS), as future roadmap capabilities may expand into this area.</li> <li>Experience with Risk Control Matrix (RCM) functionality to monitor Segregation of Duties (SOD) controls between ERP and EPM systems.</li> <li>Prior experience with other Finance Planning tools (e.g., PBCS, Adaptive Planning, Planful, Pigment, OneStream, etc is a plus).</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Conceptual understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Agentic AI frameworks</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: Social Media & Community Management Intern (Pflichtpraktikum)
description: Please note: You can send your application directly to us via email at Pausify or apply here. Up to you. *** Looking for a social media & event management internship with real responsibility? Pausify is building a platform that brings book lovers together offline. We started in Berlin, where thousands of people have already joined our sessions and we’ve built a community of 27K+ people on Instagram . Now we’re taking the next step: building a platform where anyone can find or host a Pausify session nearby — in a café, park, bakery, living room, or wherever people want to meet. Our goal is simple but ambitious: make reading more social, more visible and a bigger part of everyday life again. And we’re looking for someone who can help us tell that story and help us grow our community. The duration and number of working hours can be adjusted to the requirements of your study program. Tasks What you’ll do Support the planning, organization and management of our community events in Berlin Create content for Pausify on social media Experiment with formats and concepts and learn what works Turn Pausify events, people and our mission into good stories Get hands-on experience with Meta Ads (setting up campaigns and understanding what performs) Help shape the voice and content style of a growing brand Bring your own marketing ideas — if you see something we should try, we want to hear it! The internship is hybrid. Two days per week on-site in Berlin; the remaining days can be worked remotely. The exact arrangement can be adjusted flexibly. title: Technical Recruiter (Berlin)

title: Staff Software Engineer, Vehicle Configuration Platform
description: About Us Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world. The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone. Role Summary A single firmware release must serve every vehicle variant we build across both Rivian and all Volkswagen brands. The vehicle configuration platform that the OTA team supports makes that possible: a schema-driven system that defines every configurable attribute of a vehicle and provisions them onto vehicles in the factory, in service, and over the air customer updates. Getting this wrong can mean anything from the wrong information showing on the driver display to a car that needs to be towed in for service. You will be a technical leader on the team that owns this platform, working as a peer to its lead architect. Where the architect drives the structural evolution of the configuration system itself, you will own the health, reliability, and scalability of everything around it: the compilation and code generation pipelines, the validation and release infrastructure, the provisioning path from schema to vehicle, and the developer experience of every engineer who touches configuration. You will set technical direction for this surface area, drive initiatives that span firmware, build infrastructure, release engineering, OTA, and factory integration across two companies' engineering organizations, and raise the bar for how the team designs, reviews, and ships. This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed. Responsibilities Own the technical direction for configuration tooling, validation, and delivery infrastructure, translating platform architecture into a concrete, sequenced roadmap and driving it to completion across teams. Lead initiatives that simplify the platform: consolidating redundant mechanisms, retiring legacy pathways, and reducing the coordination cost of routine changes, while every downstream consumer keeps working. Design the compatibility strategy for data contracts deployed to devices in the field, and build the automated enforcement that makes schema evolution provably safe rather than carefully reviewed. Architect the validation and release pipeline as a product: define what classes of defects must be impossible to merge, and build the layered checks, staged rollouts, and observability that get there. Serve as the senior escalation point for production configuration issues, leading root cause analysis during launches and field events and converting each incident into systemic prevention. Drive alignment across organizational boundaries, negotiating shared contracts, review processes, and release mechanics with firmware, cloud, diagnostics, manufacturing, and partner-brand stakeholders who have differing constraints and conventions. title: Staff Software Engineer, OTA Platform
description: About Us Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world. The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone. Role Summary The Over-the-Air (OTA) Platform team builds the software delivery backbone for the vehicle: firmware updates, ECU configuration management, and software/hardware compatibility validation across the vehicle's compute and ECU landscape. The Germany-based OTA engineering group works in close, daily collaboration with the core OTA development team headquartered in Palo Alto, California, extending platform architecture to European vehicle programs and regional ECU suppliers, and representing site-specific requirements back into the global roadmap. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to anchor and grow our Over-the-Air (OTA) engineering capability at our Germany site. In this role, you will own architecture-level decisions for OTA features spanning firmware updates, configuration updates, and software/hardware mismatch handling, working in tight lockstep with the OTA development team in Palo Alto. You will be the senior technical voice for OTA in Germany — driving site development activities, setting technical direction, mentoring engineers, and ensuring the Germany team's contributions integrate cleanly into a single, global OTA architecture. This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed. Responsibilities Develop OTA features and services covering firmware update delivery, ECU/software configuration updates, and software-hardware mismatch detection and remediation. Collaborate daily with the OTA development team in Palo Alto on system architecture, API contracts, and release planning; ensure Germany-site work streams stay aligned with the global OTA roadmap. Design update strategies (full-image, delta/differential, A/B partitioning) that guarantee safe, resumable, and rollback-capable updates across heterogeneous ECUs. Define and evolve the software/hardware compatibility (mismatch) framework, including version dependency graphs, pre-condition checks, and campaign eligibility rules. Drive interface and contract discussions with cloud/backend teams (campaign orchestration, telemetry ingestion, update eligibility services) to keep vehicle-side and cloud-side assumptions in sync. Work with communication protocol stacks used for in-vehicle and vehicle-to-cloud data exchange (e.g., UDS/ISO 14229, DoIP, SOME/IP, CAN/CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, TLS/mTLS, MQTT) to integrate OTA services with ECUs and cloud endpoints. Ensure OTA processes meet automotive security and safety expectations: secure boot, cryptographic signing/verification, key management, and compliance-oriented practices aligned with ISO/SAE 21434 and UNECE R156 (Software Update Management System). Partner with QA, functional safety, cybersecurity, and vehicle integration teams to validate updates through bench, HIL, and vehicle-level testing. Support root-cause analysis and resolution of field issues related to update failures, mismatches, or rollback scenarios. Take a leading role in architecture reviews and design decisions for the global OTA platform, representing Germany-site needs and constraints while upholding overall system coherence. Drive Germany-site development activities end-to-end: technical planning, design reviews, code quality standards, and delivery execution. Mentor and provide technical guidance to Senior and mid-level engineers on the Germany team; review designs and code for correctness, performance, and maintainability. Identify architectural risks and technical debt early; propose and lead initiatives to address them across the OTA stack. Act as a key escalation point for complex, cross-cutting technical issues spanning firmware, middleware, and cloud interfaces. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time in embedded, systems, or automotive software. Demonstrated experience owning system or platform architecture for a production software product, ideally in automotive, IoT, or another safety- or reliability-critical domain. Track record of leading technical initiatives across multiple engineers or teams, including cross-site or cross-organization collaboration. Experience directly interfacing with a partner engineering team in a different location/time zone to align on architecture and delivery. Strong, hands-on proficiency in C++ and Rust — this is a core, non-negotiable requirement, as the majority of OTA services are implemented in these languages. Solid understanding of embedded Linux / POSIX-compliant operating environments and the constraints of resource-limited automotive compute platforms. Practical experience with in-vehicle and vehicle-to-cloud communication protocols (e.g., CAN/CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP, UDS/DoIP, TLS, MQTT, gRPC/Protobuf, or comparable). Comfortable driving technical interface discussions directly with cloud/backend engineering teams — defining APIs, data contracts, and failure-handling behavior across the vehicle-cloud boundary. Experience with version control, code review workflows, and CI/CD for embedded or systems software. Working knowledge of cryptographic concepts used in secure software delivery: digital signatures, certificate/key management, and secure boot chains. Strong debugging skills across layers — application logic, OS/driver interaction, and hardware/bus-level communication. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Fluent English (spoken and written) for daily collaboration with the Palo Alto team; German language skills are a plus for local site interactions. Willingness to travel occasionally to Palo Alto, CA (or host virtual overlap hours) to support cross-site architecture and planning. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience specifically in OTA/software update systems for vehicles or other connected embedded devices. Experience establishing or scaling a new engineering site or team within a larger, distributed organization. Exposure to Machine Learning / AI techniques applied to edge compute — e.g., anomaly detection on update telemetry, predictive mismatch detection, or on-device inference constraints. Automotive middleware development experience on POSIX-based ECUs (e.g., AUTOSAR Adaptive, Linux-based domain/zone controllers, or similar middleware frameworks). Familiarity with Yocto/embedded Linux build systems and board support packages. Experience with functional safety practices (ISO 26262) and automotive cybersecurity standards (ISO/SAE 21434). Knowledge of software bill of materials (SBOM) tooling and dependency/version management at fleet scale. Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test environments and automotive diagnostic tooling. Familiarity with containerization or virtualization on embedded targets (e.g., lightweight containers, hypervisors) for update isolation. Prior experience in a distributed/multi-site engineering organization, including asynchronous collaboration across time zones. title: Senior Territory Account Executive, San Francisco
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: San Francisco Bay area<br></strong></h3> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <p><strong>About this Role</strong></p> <p>This role within the mid-market segment focuses on both the acquisition of new Territory accounts, as well as the expansion of existing customer accounts.  Within the mid-market segment, you will work a set of accounts in the territory sub-segments. The ideal candidate will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams.  </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and execute a comprehensive account/territory plan to achieve quarterly sales and annual revenue targets in a defined territory and/or account list.</li> <li>Drive new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross sell Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within your territory.</li> <li>Engage in account mapping sessions with partners, including training new partners on our technology and GTM strategies.</li> <li>Developing scalable relationships with target partners, to expand partner ecosystem in a specific region.</li> <li>Build a robust sales pipeline through continual engagement and nurturing of key prospect accounts.</li> <li>Understand customer use-cases and how they pair with Cloudflare’s portfolio solutions in order to identify new sales opportunities.</li> <li>Craft and communicate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services. Drive awareness through regular outbound campaigns on product and feature roadmap updates. </li> <li>Accurately forecast commercial outcomes by running a consistent sales process, including driving next step expectations and contract negotiations.</li> <li>As a trusted advisor, build long-term strategic relationships with key accounts, to ensure customer adoption, retention and expansion. Regularly evaluate usage trends and articulate value to show Cloudflare impact and provide strategic recommendations during business reviews. </li> <li>Network across different business units with each of your accounts, and multi-thread to identify and engage new divisional buyers.</li> <li>Position Cloudflare's platform in each of your target customers, including Cloudflare One and the Connectivity Cloud to realize our full potential in every customer.</li> <li>Operate internally as a liaison with cross-functional teams to share key customer feedback and insights to improve customer experience and further investments with Cloudflare.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of direct B2B selling experience</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment</li> <li>Bachelor's degree required</li> <li>Demonstrated analytical and quantitative abilities</li> <li>Software and system skills are a must (SFDC, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years in Software/SaaS/Security Sales & Channel management.</li> <li>Existing relationships and/or strong familiarity of the partner ecosystem in the region that they cover.</li> <li>Understanding of cloud infrastructure ecosystem and cloud security is highly preferred.</li> <li>Experience working in a start-up environment.</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.</li> <li>Technical competence strongly preferred.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <p>For Bay Area-based hires: Estimated annual salary of $244,000 - $336,000</p> <p>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong><br>The role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Founding Engineer (all genders)
description: Gynaecological care the way it's supposed to be: Personalised, easy to reach, effective. Women are diagnosed on average four years later than men, across 770 different diseases. They spend 25 % more of their lives in poor health. That is the gender health gap, and science says two things keep it open: too little access to specialists in women's health, and far too little research on women in the first place. femote works on both. Step One: we turn ordinary statutory gynaecological practices into digital care champions. So that the specialists we do have can care for more patients properly, within the resources they are given. Step Two: we turn generalist doctors into specialists by equipping them with clinical diagnostic and decision support built specifically for women's health, trained on data collected by Step One. Where we stand Supported by leaders of the German gynaecological medical associations Backed by industry angels from pharmaceuticals and medical publishing Innovation grant secured from the German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy Part of the Lausitz Model Region, giving us deep integration into the statutory system and reach to women regardless of their spending power MVP in pilot phase with real practices (Stack: Flutter, Supabase, Postgres. Up for debate once you join) Pre-seed stage, with funding in place to bring you on Tasks We are looking for our first engineer to build femote's product and shape the technical foundation it grows on. As our founding engineer, you will build our first SaaS product, a patient app and a professional interface, under European General Product Safety Regulation guidelines in the first year while we prepare for medical device certification in year two. Every case we capture is structured so it can carry clinical evidence later, which is what makes algorithmic and decision-support features possible at all. You will not build those alone, but you need to direct that work, and the architecture that makes it possible has to be laid now. Requirements We value smartness, humility and the ability to learn and adapt quickly over hard skills on paper. Please apply, even if you don't tick all the boxes. What you have done Experience running a SaaS product from building to shipping to operating in production Strong data modelling and processing , including consent, provenance and pseudonymisation, so captured data can lawfully support clinical evidence and model training later Bonus: experience building algorithmic or AI-enabled features Bonus: experience building in a regulated field (MDR, AI Act, or similar) Bonus: German speaking, though not required How you work You ship fast without lowering the bar. Short iteration cycles and pragmatic solutions, with engineering practices solid enough to stand up to a notified body. You set the pattern, not just the code. Everything the first engineer does becomes the default for everyone after. You write it down, you teach it, and you build with that in mind. You do not think in taboos. You will be reading about discharge, bleeding and pelvic pain at nine in the morning and building interfaces for it. If that is awkward for you, this is not your role. You want to understand why we are doing this in gynaecology. You do not have to arrive as an expert in women's health, and we are happy to offer a steep learning curve. The curiosity has to be yours. You are reflective. You take feedback without putting armour on, and you say when you are stuck rather than when it is already too late. Benefits Meaningful equity as hurdle shares or an instrument with equivalent tax treatment. Genuine ownership of the technical direction Full-time, with flexible working hours Room to grow into the CTO role: owning medical device certification, security and data handling, the engineering team you hire around you, and representing femote's technical direction to regulators, partners and investors. Our hiring process Conversation with Frederike (45 min): what we are building, what you have built, and whether this is the right fit for both sides. Meet the team: Tabea and Insa, the people you will work with every day. Technical deep dive with one of our technical advisors: architecture, data modelling and how you would approach our product. Offer. From application to offer takes no longer than six weeks. Who you will work with We are a small team, and between us we have treated patients, built data infrastructure and products for enterprise clients, and studied how health systems fail people at scale. Our team is technical enough that you don't have to translate engineering reality into business language. Frederike Kugland, Founder: Quit her job for yeast infections. Built a company around it. WHU graduate turned developer. Ex-Managing Partner at tech consultancy Pandata. Learned to code because she hated Excel, now runs product, fundraising and sales. Technical enough to be your sparring partner but too busy to interfere with your work. Doesn't shy away from founder-led marketing, discussing her intimate health on the Gyncast Podcast. Dr. med. Tabea Siebler, Medical Lead: Doctor. Polyglot. One exam room isn't enough for her. Certified gynaecologist, speaks 6 languages, not as a Duolingo streak but to serve her patients. Implemented a new consultation hour for Female Genital Mutilation and Cutting at her last clinic. Currently studying Public Health at the London School of Hygiene because treating one patient at a time wasn't enough. Insa Deden, Software Development: Left the ward to build what was missing on it. Trained and worked as a registered nurse in anaesthesia at University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf, then went to study health information management to work on the problems she had been living with every shift. She brings the care-delivery perspective that sits next to Tabea's clinical one: what it actually takes for software to hold up at scale in daily practice, rather than in a demo. Moving from working student to full-time. Alongside them: a fractional CFO, regulatory and compliance support from the former Head of Regulatory at Heidelberg Engineering, and technical advisors. title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description: As our Senior Analytics Engineer for Operations, you'll own that data end to end, the model behind it, the metrics it produces, and the trust the business places in both. This role isn't just "build the metric, ship the dashboard." We want someone who looks past the number to the process behind it, where it's manual, where it's fragile, where the right tool removes the work instead of just reporting on it. You'll have a direct line to influencing how those processes and the surrounding product actually work, not just how they're measured. You'll sit embedded inside Operations, partnering with the TRI (Trust & Risk Intelligence) domain wherever the two overlap, while working inside the Data & Analytics team's AE guild — so you'll have the tools and the context to actually contribute, not just execute. What You Will Be Doing Own the Operations data model — reconciliation, treasury, payments, lifecycle, and onboarding — turning raw operational events into documented, trustworthy data products on the DWH Partner directly with Operations stakeholders on day-to-day questions, ad hoc requests, and recurring reporting, acting as their primary data point of contact — while pushing routine, repeatable questions toward self-service instead of answering the same thing by hand every time Look past the metric to the process behind it — understand how everything actually works end to end, spot where manual effort or fragile handoffs are the real problem, and identify which tools (not just which query) would solve it Define and maintain key metrics for reconciliation accuracy, treasury positions, payment success/failure rates, and onboarding conversion, working within the team's central metric architecture Participate in data quality and governance practices for the domain Bring process and product ideas to the table directly — you're close enough to the operational reality to see what should change, and this role expects you to say so and help make it happen, not just report the numbers upward Your First Six Months First month Learn the Operations domain and how it currently works and reports, end to end. Meet your stakeholders and your teammates. Ship a first small, well-scoped fix or data product from the existing backlog to get real signal into the system quickly First 3 months Own at least one Operations sub-domain's metrics end to end. Start contributing to the shared Risk/TRI conversations, and bring your first concrete process or tooling suggestion to a stakeholder — something you noticed while getting close to the actual workflow First 6 months Operations stakeholders treat you as their data partner, not the new person. Routine checks are answered by self-service — what reaches you is what actually needs a person. You hold real, independent ownership over the data and workflows under your supervision Who You Are You've worked as an analytics engineer or senior analyst on technical projects involving data modeling on a modern data platform (Databricks, Spark, or dbt) — not just querying data others built You write excellent SQL for analytical work, and you can pick up Python for anything SQL doesn't cover well You're confident gathering requirements directly from operational stakeholders and turning ambiguous asks into clean, documented metrics You default to precision over speed when the two are in tension — Operations data feeds regulatory and financial reporting, and being wrong quietly is worse than being slow You can hold two stakeholders' definitions of "the same" metric and reconcile them, rather than picking whichever is more convenient You think past the metric to the process it describes — you want to understand how the domain's tasks actually get done, spot which tool or automation would remove real work rather than just report on it, and you push for that change rather than waiting to be asked You have a high level of autonomy and self-direction — you're the one who decides what needs fixing, not just how to measure it AI-assisted workflows and tools are just part of how you work, not a novelty Nice to Have Background in banking, fintech, treasury, or payments operations Experience working across multiple stakeholder groups with overlapping but not identical needs Familiarity with regulatory or financial reporting data requirements Occasional exposure to BI-layer reporting (PSM, lifecycle, or similar) when it intersects with your data products What You Will Get In Return Make a genuine impact on the product Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. title: (Senior) Consultant & Project Manager (m/w/d)
description: Deine Rolle Du berätst unsere Kunden dabei, was ein Projekt erreichen soll, und verantwortest, dass es dort ankommt. Als (Senior) Consultant & Project Manager arbeitest du an Projekten und Produkten in Commerce, Daten und KI, vom ersten Workshop bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson des Kunden, führst die Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung und Partnern und übernimmst Product Ownership. Deine Aufgaben Beraten Du klärst mit dem Kunden, was ein Projekt erreichen soll, und übersetzt seine Geschäftsziele in Produktentscheidungen. Du leitest Discovery-Workshops mit Fachbereichen und empfiehlst, was gebaut wird und was nicht. Nach dem Go-live prüfst du mit dem Kunden, ob das Projekt die Kennzahlen bewegt, für die es gestartet wurde. Steuern Du planst und steuerst mehrere Projekte parallel und verantwortest Zeit, Budget und Qualität. Du übernimmst Product Ownership: Du priorisierst das Backlog und triffst Scope-Entscheidungen mit dem Kunden. Du sprichst Zielkonflikte früh an und führst Entscheidungen herbei. Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, UX und Daten-Teams zusammen und begleitest Releases, Go-lives und die Weiterentwicklung danach. Du nutzt KI in deiner eigenen Arbeit und entwickelst unsere Methoden weiter. Als Senior berätst du Kunden bis auf Führungsebene, führst größere oder strategische Projekte, bist fest in Angebote und Pitches eingebunden und unterstützt andere Kolleginnen und Kollegen mit deiner Erfahrung. Dein Profil Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Beratung, Projektmanagement oder Product Ownership bei technischen Digitalprojekten, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder Beratung. Erfahrung mit Projekten in Commerce, Daten oder KI. Erfahrung mit agentischen Lösungen ist ein Plus. Du denkst in Kennzahlen des Kunden und kannst Fachbereichen erklären, was eine technische Entscheidung für ihr Geschäft bedeutet. Du steuerst Budget und Scope sicher, auch wenn mehrere Projekte parallel laufen. Du arbeitest agil oder klassisch, je nachdem, was das Projekt braucht. Du sprichst mit Kunden auf Augenhöhe und sprichst Konflikte an, bevor sie teuer werden. Erfahrung mit Workshops auf Fachbereichs- oder Führungsebene ist ein Plus. Sehr gutes Deutsch (mindestens C1) und gutes Englisch. Was dich erwartet Projekte mit Händlern und Herstellern auf einem modernen Composable-Stack, mit Partnern wie commercetools, Snowflake und weiteren. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege. Austausch mit anderen Consultants, Project Managern und Product Ownern im Team. Ein klarer Weg vom Project Manager zum Senior, mit der Möglichkeit, dich in Discovery, Pitches und Beratung einzubringen. Weiterbildung ist bei uns fest vorgesehen: Du schlägst Konferenzen, Kurse oder Zertifizierungen vor, und wir planen sie gemeinsam ein. KI-Werkzeuge und moderne Hardware als selbstverständlicher Teil der Arbeit. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Template of Member of Technical Staff — Full-Stack
description: Member of Technical Staff — Full-Stack Remanence is pioneering the next era of enterprise AI by building intelligent systems that learn continuously from real-world execution. We transform complex enterprise workflows and business context into dynamic, interactive environments where AI agents can safely learn, adapt, and improve. By combining high-fidelity simulation environments with state-of-the-art training loops, we build specialized models that solve long-horizon, complex tasks with unmatched reliability. We're building the most talent-dense AI team in Europe to make this happen. You’ll build the product through which researchers and customers use Remanence: the web application, APIs, SDKs, and backend services connecting agent activity to evaluation and training. Your goal is to turn complex research capabilities into an intuitive platform that customers can use independently. What you'll work on Build interfaces for exploring agent traces, creating environments and verifiers, launching training runs, and comparing evaluations. Develop APIs and SDKs that connect customers’ existing agents, tools, and data to Remanence. Build backend workflows for sandboxed agent sessions, evaluations, and training jobs, with live progress, cancellation, retries, and clear failure handling. Implement platform foundations including authentication, permissions, customer isolation, and audit trails. Own features from prototype to production, working directly with researchers and customers to turn deployment feedback into reusable product capabilities. Own your services in production: testing, observability, performance and on-call. Relevant technologies Backend: Python, Rust, FastAPI or Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, REST and gRPC. Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js, and interfaces for streaming events and data visualization. Platform: Docker, Kubernetes, Ray, and durable workflow orchestration such as Temporal. Bonus: Rust, Python/TypeScript SDK development, or experience building tools for agents and ML workflows. Strong production experience building backend systems in Python is mandatory. About you You're a strong backend engineer who is comfortable shipping a clean, useful interface. You care about API design, data modeling and correctness under concurrency and failure. You enjoy working closely with researchers and customers, and turning rough needs into tools people rely on. We welcome both experienced specialists and generalists who learn exceptionally quickly. Experience deploying agents in production is nice to have. But prior ML experience is not required; evidence of shipping and owning production software matters. What we offer Competitive compensation and equity. A fast-paced environment combining frontier research with impactful real-world applications. Visa sponsorship and relocation support for candidates joining us. A flexible hybrid setup, with a preference for working together in person. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Brand lead
description: About H: H exists to push the boundaries of superintelligence with agentic AI. By automating complex, multi-step tasks typically performed by humans, AI agents will help unlock full human potential. The Role Today, H is known for its story: its founders, its funding rounds, its press. We want it to be known for its value. Your mission is to make H one of the top 3 brands that large-enterprise decision-makers think of in enterprise AI, in France first, then in the US. You will be our Brand lead, and the owner of the Brand pillar of our marketing strategy, alongside Growth and Product Marketing. You'll take over a brand foundation that is being shaped right now (positioning, identity, messaging house) and turn it into a brand that holds for the next five years in a market that reinvents itself every quarter. Our brand stance is that of a pragmatic visionary : bold on vision, precise and evidence-led on capability. You'll be the guardian of that balance, making sure every piece of work speaks the language of the boardroom and holds up to the scrutiny of a CTO/builder. You'll work hand in hand with leadership, Product, Research, Sales, our FDE teams and Communications, and with our external brand and PR agencies. What You'll Do Lead the brand relaunch (Foundations) Take ownership of the new brand platform: positioning, identity, tone of voice and messaging house, and drive its rollout internally and externally. Turn our convictions into a story that is ours: what we believe, why we exist, what makes our approach to enterprise problems unique. Build a brand system that flexes by market (France, UK, US) without losing coherence, and that separates our two registers: a bold "vision voice" and a precise "capability voice". Set and enforce brand guidelines across every touchpoint: website, decks, events, product, recruiting. Shift the narrative (Reputation) Move the public conversation about H from founders and funding to product, value and customer outcomes. Make trust a brand signal: reliability, ownership, resilience and our research-first approach (we own our models, we are not a wrapper), carried through proof rather than claims. Co-own reputation with Communications: Brand defines the positioning, Communications amplifies it through PR and executive voice. Build awareness where our buyers are (Awareness) Design the brand plan that puts H in front of large-account decision-makers: flagship events, recurring PR moments, ecosystem programmes, content and campaigns. Prepare and lead the brand side of our US launch. Partner with Growth so awareness turns into qualified relationships and pipeline. Earn authority (Authority) Grow H's thought leadership around the execution gap in enterprise AI and "AI that actually works". Lead strategic sponsorships and labels (e.g. Institut Polytechnique de Paris, our Resilient AI label) and partnerships with academics and consulting firms. Build the function Manage brand budget and agencies (brand studio, freelancers). Hire and lead the Brand team as it grows, starting with a Content Manager. title: Technical Product Manager – Integrations & Connectors (m/f/d)
description: Your mission Construction companies run their tenders across many tools. Your mission is to make Cosuno the place where it all comes together. The deeper Cosuno sits in our customers' processes, the more value we create for them. At the same time, AI assistants like Claude and Gemini are becoming how people work. You'll launch our first MCP server so that our customers can analyze their data and operate Cosuno straight from their AI assistant. How you'll get there: Get to know our customers. Your first weeks are all about listening. You'll talk to customers and find out what it takes for our REST API and connectors to become part of their daily work. Together with Engineering, Customer Success and Sales, you'll turn those insights into a clear roadmap. You'll also set up the tracking that shows how much of our customers' work flows in through integrations. Launch the first API improvements and our first MCP server. You'll shape both, write the engineering tickets and roll them out to our first pilot customers, all within your first few months. Decide what comes next. Once real usage data and pilot feedback come in, you'll make clear recommendations on what to build and decide on the way forward together with our CTO and Head of Product. Make integrations the norm. By the end of your first year, far more of our customers will run Cosuno connected to the tools they rely on, and you'll be the one who made it happen. It's an ambitious plan, and that's what makes it fun: you'll see the impact of your work directly in our customers' day-to-day. How we work: Full ownership: You own integrations end to end, from the first customer conversation to the shipped feature. Engineering takes care of the implementation. Close to the customer: You'll talk to customers constantly, mostly remotely, sometimes on-site across Germany. Technical by nature: You'll read API docs, test endpoints yourself and discuss data models with engineers. You don't write production code. AI-first: We use AI deeply in our product and in our daily work, and we expect you to do the same. What you bring: You've shaped an API from the product side. You've defined, together with customers and engineering, what a public API or integration of a SaaS product exposes: endpoints, data models, auth, permissions. You're technical enough to go deep with engineers. Webhooks vs. polling, pagination, rate limits, OAuth: you can discuss trade-offs, and you test APIs yourself. You find the real need. You've worked directly with customers, separated what they ask for from what they really need, and found what it takes for them to use an integration. You write tickets engineers love. Clear scope, clear acceptance criteria, and a clear line on what's out of scope. You prioritize by impact, not by who shouts loudest. You're fast. You ship in weeks, not quarters, and you build, learn and iterate in parallel. You explain complex things simply , to a construction company's project manager as well as to internal stakeholders like our commercial teams or our management. You live AI. You use LLM assistants and MCPs every day, and you've built your own automations. You keep growing. You actively build your skills, and you seek and act on feedback. Fluent German and English. Our customers are German construction companies who work in German. Our engineering team works in English. Based in Germany and open to traveling to customers across the country. Bonus points if you've helped build an MCP server that customers use, or if you know construction tech, ERP or estimating systems (e.g. RIB iTWO, SAP, Nevaris). Why us? Real impact: You'll shape how an entire industry connects its software and how AI agents work with it. Competitive compensation: A salary above the market average. Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Germany, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, with flexible working hours. Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro. A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events. Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company. Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations with our Head of Product. About us Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology. We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity. Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs. But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An inclusive work environment is a given for us. Join us – Build the future of construction. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Hardware
description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors. You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them. This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage. What You Will Do Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why. Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree. Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room. Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets. Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy. Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability. Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured. Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result. Requirements You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale. Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today. You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer. You have led engineers: hired them, grown them, and kept a team shipping through 0-to-1 ambiguity. Typically 6+ years in hardware, but we care more about what you shipped than how long it took. A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly. Experience taking hardware to small-batch production: DFM, vendor and EMS management, test, and certification. Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice. High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. A 0-to-1 hardware program takes the hours it takes, in person and at pace, and you have chosen that before. Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care. Nice to Have Wearables, smartwatches, drones, robotics, AR/VR, or defense wearables on your résumé. Camera systems: sensor selection, MIPI and ISP pipelines, and multi-camera synchronization. Low-power and battery design, BLE or Wi-Fi, and antenna integration in small enclosures. Enough mechanical fluency (CAD, tolerances, and materials) to challenge the mechanical team’s choices and be right some of the time. Prior founder or founding-engineer experience, including the parts that went wrong. Open-source hardware or firmware contributions. Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits: Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it. Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it. Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them. Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes. This is for you if: You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec. You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one. You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do. This is not for you if: You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5. You would forward output you cannot explain. "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer. How We Hire We read every application and reply within five working days. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem. Then a decision, usually within a few days. Pay Transparency Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting. What We Offer Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter. Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval. A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage. Free food and drinks in the office. Equal Opportunity MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive H/F – CDI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p>Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</p> <p><strong>À propos de WPP Media :</strong></p> <p>WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance. Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie.</p> <p>Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing.</p> <p>Pour plus d’informations, visitez <a href="http://www.wpp.com/">www.wpp.com</a>.</p> <p>WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents, nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="http://www.wppmedia.com">www.wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p>Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes.</p> <p>Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Être Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li><strong>Créer un environnement Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.</li> <li><strong>Diriger avec Optimisme</strong> en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rôle et missions :</strong></p> <p><strong><u>Contexte & Équipe :</u></strong><br>Dans le cadre d’un remplacement, vous intégrez une <strong>Business Unit (BU) de 6 personnes</strong>. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique.</p> <p>Vous serez encadré directement par une Account Director au sein de la BU, et travaillerez en lien étroit avec le Business Partner de la BU.</p> <p>Vous prendrez en charge la gestion opérationnelle et le suivi stratégique d'un portefeuille de 3 comptes clients majeurs et stimulants :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Secteur de la FoodTech & Livraison rapide : </strong>Nouveau compte global d'envergure internationale. Vous participerez au déploiement local des campagnes en France et assurerez la coordination avec l'équipe globale basée au UK. C'est un compte à fort enjeu stratégique offrant une réelle autonomie et une marge de manœuvre en local.</li> <li><strong>Secteur de l'Énergie & de la Mobilité : </strong>Suivi des campagnes multi-leviers (Search, Social, Digital, Sponsoring).</li> <li><strong>Secteur de la Grande Consommation (FMCG) / Agroalimentaire : </strong>Accompagnement du plan de relance d'une marque référente, à l'occasion du lancement d'une nouvelle catégorie de produits innovante via des dispositifs média à fort impact (Opérations Spéciales, Influence, Retail Media...).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Missions principales :</strong><br>Au sein de l’équipe conseil, vous travaillerez sur la gestion et le suivi quotidien des campagnes média sur ce portefeuille :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Prise de briefs clients</strong> : Analyse des besoins, compréhension des objectifs de marque et interface opérationnelle avec les clients.</li> <li><strong>Analyses de concurrence & pige</strong> : Élaboration d'analyses qualitatives et quantitatives (suivi des investissements média et décryptage des stratégies de communication concurrentes).</li> <li><strong>Participation à l’élaboration des plans pluri-média</strong> : Contribution à la construction des stratégies d'investissement et des plans média (TV, Digital, Social, Search, OPS, Retail Media, etc.).</li> <li><strong>Gestion des relations internes et externes</strong> : Coordination régulière avec les experts média internes (Digital, Social, Search...) et avec les régies publicitaires (présentation d'études, participation aux rencontres régies).</li> <li><strong>Suivi opérationnel & financier</strong> : Établissement des devis clients, gestion de la facturation, suivi de la diffusion et optimisation des campagnes.</li> <li><strong>Bilans & Recommandations</strong> : Élaboration des reportings clients, analyse des performances et formulation d'enseignements stratégiques.</li> <li><strong>Coordination internationale</strong> : Échanges réguliers et reportings en anglais avec l'équipe globale (notamment au UK).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Profil Recherché :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Formation & Expérience</strong> : Bac+4/5 (École de Commerce, de Communication ou Master spécialisé). Vous justifiez idéalement d'une <strong>première expérience (stage, alternance ou 1er emploi)</strong> en agence média ou chez l'annonceur dans le domaine de la publicité.</li> <li><strong>Langues</strong> : <strong>Niveau d’anglais opérationnel à courant indispensable</strong> (échanges fréquents à l'écrit et à l'oral avec les équipes globales internationales/UK).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compétences clés</strong> :</p> <ul> <li>Très à l’aise avec les chiffres, rigoureux et très organisé.</li> <li>Maîtrise des outils bureautiques (Excel, PowerPoint).</li> <li>Intérêt affirmé pour l'écosystème média traditionnel et digital (Social, Search, Retail Media, OPS).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualités humaines</strong> :</p> <ul> <li>Esprit d'équipe et goût du travail en co-construction.</li> <li>Réactivité, autonomie et polyvalence.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :</strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur.</p> <p>Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.</p> <p>Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.</p> <p><strong>Nos avantages comprennent :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Télétravail</strong> : jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année.</li> <li><strong>Congés offerts</strong> : 2 jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte.</li> <li><strong>Ancienneté</strong> : Jours de congé additionnels par palier de 5 ans d’ancienneté.</li> <li><strong>Santé & Équité</strong> : 5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaboratrices souffrant d’endométriose.</li> <li><strong>Politique handicap</strong> : 3 jours d'absence autorisés payés par an, accès à des Chèques Emploi Service Universel, et accompagnements spécifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH.</li> <li><strong>Engagement sociétal</strong> : Missions solidaires possibles via le programme <em>We care and we act</em>.</li> <li><strong>Tools</strong> : Accès à des outils performants et à la pointe de la technologie pour la gestion des campagnes et le reporting (WPP Open).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process de recrutement :</strong></p> <p>Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Entretien avec l’équipe Recrutement</strong> : Un premier entretien téléphonique ou par vidéoconférence avec l’équipe Talent pour aborder votre parcours et échanger sur le poste.</li> <li><strong>Entretiens Opérationnels</strong> : Un entretien avec l’Account Director au sein de la BU, suivi d'un échange avec le Business Partner de la BU.</li> <li><strong>Étude de cas</strong> : Une étude de cas technique vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques et analytiques liées au poste, suivie d’un temps de restitution et d'échange direct lors de l’entretien.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.</p> <p>Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données : politique de confidentialité.</p> <p>Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures

title: Founder Associate Intern @Pelagon (backed by Hexa)
description: Who are we? The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites. Pelagon builds maritime interdiction: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies underwater and surface threats, so operators can act on them. We work with navies and with the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy. Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). Backed by Hexa and leading European investors. By joining us, you'll play a key role in keeping a fast-moving defence startup running: the paperwork, the bills and the admin processes, and getting our systems into the water. Every test, fair, demo and admin file goes through you. 🎯 Your mission Run the company's admin: paperwork, supplier invoices and bills, expense receipts, contracts and forms, insurance, permits and declarations, offices. Build the admin processes: who does what, where every document lives, which deadline comes next, so nothing slips as the team grows. Own the logistics of our equipment: inventory, orders, packing, shipping, and driving the gear to test sites. Run data collection campaigns at sea with our hardware team: prepare, deploy, recover, log the data. Make every fair and demo happen: stand material, shipping, permits, boats, set-up on site. Support the founders on the business plan and the monthly numbers. 🤩 This job is your dream job if: You like things in order: every invoice filed, every form sent on time, every deadline in your tracker You'd rather be on a boat with a sensor than in front of a slide deck You've built, deployed or repaired real things and you like it when it gets wet You plan ahead, keep checklists and follow up without being chased You want to see from the inside how a defence startup is built 🙅 This job is not for you if: You want remote work or a pure engineering design role Paperwork, bills and admin processes feel beneath you: they are a real part of this job Early starts, cold days at sea and travel at short notice put you off Requirements Engineering or science profile preferred, final year or recent graduate French fluent and working English EU citizenship (defence site access and security clearance) Driving licence (B) Based in Paris, on site full time What we offer A founding role in a seed-stage defence tech company, working directly with the founders Real deployments at sea and on navy and operator sites Offices in Paris 🧭 Our recruitment process A 30 minute intro call with Roland, our Chief of Staff. A 60 minute deep dive with Gauthier: your background, one project you built, and a short logistics exercise. A company fit conversation with Aymeric and the team. We answer within 48 h after each step. Pelagon is committed to creating a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment irrespective of gender, origin, identity, background and sexual orientation. Defence and maritime have long been male-dominated fields: we actively encourage women to apply. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Product Owner (m/w/d)
description: Crewmeister ist die führende Lösung zur Zeiterfassung und Schichtplanung von kleinen Unternehmen. Mit unserer Software unterstützen wir über 20.000 Kunden, das Stundenzettel-Chaos zu überwinden. Die Basis für unseren Erfolg sind unsere mehr als 60 Mitarbeitenden, die mit Herzblut, Neugier, Analytik und einer Menge Grips unsere Kunden mit unserem Produkt noch erfolgreicher machen. Bewirb dich dich bei uns als Product Owner , lerne von den Besten und mache unsere Erfolgsgeschichte zu deiner Erfolgsgeschichte. Dein Verantwortungsbereich: Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase wirst du immer mehr zu einem wichtigen Treiber unserer Produktvision. Das bedeutet für uns: Du bist neugierig und bestrebt, die Bedürfnisse und Herausforderungen unserer Kunden zu verstehen und verfolgst unermüdlich die bestmögliche Lösung für sie. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Entwicklungsteam zusammen, um Produktideen in die Realität umzusetzen. Dabei beginnst du mit dem Verstehen der Anforderungen und bietest kontinuierliche Unterstützung während der Implementierung. So stellst du sicher, dass unser Team ein klares und umfassendes Verständnis des Projekts und der Kundenbedürfnisse hat. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den Erfolg des Produkts: Gemeinsam mit dem Team erstellst du User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien, priorisierst Aufgaben und pflegst den Backlog. Dabei achtest du darauf, dass das Team an den wirklich wichtigen Dingen arbeitet. Du triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen, um eine reibungslose Produktimplementierung sicherzustellen, und fungierst als wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen dem Produkt- und dem Entwicklungsteam. Du hältst dich stets über offene Fehlerberichte sowie die Herausforderungen der Kunden und Stakeholder auf dem Laufenden. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem aktuellen Product Owner und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um unsere Produkt-Roadmap zu verstehen und aktiv mitzugestalten. Du bist verantwortlich für die Releases unserer mobilen App(s). Erforderliche Qualifikationen: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium oder Ähnliches. Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für Softwareentwicklung. Du hast 3-4 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Projektmanagement- oder Produktorganisation-Rolle. Du hast Erfahrung im DACH-Markt. Du hast Erfahrung mit einem Software- oder SaaS-Produkt. Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen in einem kleinen Unternehmen gesammelt. Du hast eine unerschöpfliche Neugier auf Technologie und das Verständnis der Benutzerbedürfnisse und strebst ständig nach Verbesserungen. Du bist mit agilen Werten sowie der Kanban- und Scrum-Methodik vertraut. Du hast Erfahrung im Schreiben von User Stories und im Aufteilen von Epics in nützliche Einheiten. Du bist schnell auf den Beinen und hast eine analytische, datengetriebene Denkweise. Du bringst ausgezeichnete Organisationsfähigkeiten und ein gutes Auge für Details mit.
