title: Post-doctorant.e : "Simulation numérique 3D de l’infusion de composites à fibres naturelles" - CDD 12 mois
description: ENGLISH VERSION Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain . Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur ! Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux. Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure. 🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe. 🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet ANR PRME LINEN ( Experimental and Numerical Characterisation of Flax Composite Manufacturing by Liquid Infusion: From Local Phenomena to Induced Properties ), auquel participent plusieurs chercheurs de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne , avec pour objectif d’étudier l’élaboration de pièces structurales en matériaux composites à base de fibres de lin. Ce post-doctorat, d’une durée de 12 mois est proposé pour développer la modélisation numérique de l’infusion de résine dans des préformes composites à fibres de lin. L’objectif est d’étudier, à l’échelle mésoscopique, l’influence de l’organisation anisotrope et hétérogène des torons de fibres sur l’écoulement de la résine. Le projet s’appuiera sur des simulations 3D par éléments finis , reposant sur un couplage Stokes-Darcy et la prise en compte d’un tenseur de perméabilité orthotrope. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’influence des variations locales de la fraction volumique de fibres sur la perméabilité, les chemins préférentiels d’écoulement et les effets capillaires. Les simulations seront réalisées avec le code éléments finis Cœur ( https://gitlab.emse.fr/bruchon/Coeur ) , en s’appuyant sur la bibliothèque PETSc et des solveurs itératifs préconditionnés adaptés aux problèmes de grande taille. Dans un premier temps, des architectures idéalisées de type unidirectionnel, quasi-unidirectionnel et tissé seront étudiées à l’aide d’une représentation par Level-Set . Dans un second temps, lorsque cela sera possible, des mésostructures réalistes seront reconstruites à partir d’images µ-CT . Le post-doctorant.e contribuera également au développement et à la validation de la stratégie numérique et travaillera en interaction étroite avec les travaux expérimentaux et numériques des autres tâches du projet. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Une formation en mécanique numérique, mécanique des fluides, éléments finis ou calcul scientifique est recherchée. Des compétences en C++/Python, calcul haute performance, PETSc, méthodes Level-Set ou traitement d’images 3D seront appréciées. Vous vous reconnaissez dans les capacités et aptitudes suivantes : · Capacité à travailler en équipe · Capacité à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs académiques et industriels 📩 Candidatez dès maintenant ! Date limite de candidature : 20/11/2026 🔗 Les dossiers de candidature (CV, lettre de motivation, lettre de recommandation) sont à déposer sur la plateforme RECRUITEE : https://institutminestelecom.recruitee.com/o/post-doctorante-simulation-numerique-3d-de-linfusion-de-composites-a-fibres-naturelles-cdd-12-mois Prise de poste envisagée : 1er février 2027 Les candidats retenus après examen de leur dossier de candidature seront auditionnés en entretien par visioconférence puis, le cas échéant, reçus pour un entretien en présentiel à Mines Saint-Étienne. Dans le cadre de sa politique Égalité, Diversité et Inclusion, l’École des Mines de Saint Etienne est un employeur soucieux de l’équité de traitement entre les candidatures. ℹ️ Informations complémentaires CDD de droit public d’une durée de 12 mois La rémunération sera fixée selon le profil du candidat, en fonction des règles définies par le cadre de gestion de l’Institut Mines Télécom Temps plein - profil Cadre Poste basé à Saint-Étienne à l’École des Mines. Des déplacements dans la zone urbaine de l’aire urbaine stéphanoise seront à prévoir pour travailler sur les plateformes. Le poste est ouvert à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap. Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde . Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver : · Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain · Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an · Une qualité de vie incomparable : entre 46 et 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science , l’ ingénierie , et des projets qui font sens . title: Head of Credit Risk Oversight
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Roles like this don't come along often.</p> <p>You'll lead the oversight of Monzo Bank Europe’s whole lending business. You'll spot the risks inthe portfolio before they show up in the numbers, so Monzo Bank Europe can grow fast and keep growing.</p> <p>You'll also lead our credit risk analytics and measurement. You'll direct the development of our IFRS 9 expected credit loss models, make sure our impairment provisions hold up, and turn portfolio data into insight the business acts on. You'll do that with modern methods and technology, including artificial intelligence, and set the standard for how we use and control them.</p> <p>This role reports to the Director of Credit Risk, Monzo Bank Europe.</p> <p><em>The role you are applying for is a Controlled Function (CF-2) within the meaning of the Central Bank Reform Act, 2010. For this role, appointment will be conditional on Monzo being fully satisfied that the appointee meets the requirements as set out in the Fitness and Probity Standards 2018 issued by the Central Bank of Ireland. As a CF, the role holder will be subject to Conduct Standards under the Central Bank of Ireland Individual Accountability Framework and will be required to take reasonable steps to ensure that the relevant conduct standards are met.</em></p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> Credit Risk Framework and Appetite</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Developing, implementing and continuously improving our Credit Risk Framework in Europe, keeping it aligned to the entity's strategy.</li> <li>Formulating and overseeing the Credit Risk Appetite Statement and its limit structure, so lending growth stays inside agreed boundaries.</li> <li>Turning appetite into practical limits, triggers and escalation paths, and overseeing how the First Line of Defence (1st LoD) puts them into practice.</li> <li>Embedding group-wide credit risk frameworks locally, with clear escalation between global standards and local policy.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> 2nd LoD oversight of credit risk activities</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Giving independent oversight and challenge across credit policy, underwriting and credit decisioning strategies, affordability, pricing, and collections and recovery.</li> <li>Issuing formal 2nd LoD opinions on new products, policy and strategy changes, and material lending decisions.</li> <li>Reviewing portfolio asset quality regularly, including performance trends, vintage analysis and emerging pockets of risk.</li> <li>Overseeing the adequacy assessment of IFRS 9 impairment provisions, and giving a clear 2nd LoD view on whether provisions are appropriate.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Credit risk measurement</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Leading the measurement of our credit risk end to end, from data and methodology through to the loss estimates we report.</li> <li>Owning the development and maintenance of the IFRS 9 expected credit loss models, including the PD, LGD, EAD and forward-looking information (FLI) inputs behind them.</li> <li>Setting the methodology for staging, significant increase in credit risk, macroeconomic scenarios and post-model adjustments.</li> <li>Keeping model documentation and evidence in good shape, and closing validation findings on time.</li> <li>Bringing advanced techniques and artificial intelligence into how we build and run these models, with the controls and transparency that come with them.</li> <li>Supplying credit risk parameters and expert input to capital, stress testing and financial planning work.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Monitoring, early warning and MI</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Building credit risk monitoring and early warning processes that spot problems early.</li> <li>Delivering high quality, timely credit risk management information and insight to senior internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Making the numbers tell a clear story, so people can make decisions quickly and confidently.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Committee governance and independent challenge</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Acting as Secretariat and Deputy Chair of the Credit Risk Oversight Committee, shaping agendas, tracking actions, and presenting 2nd LoD reports and opinions.</li> <li>Escalating credit risk appetite breaches and material risks promptly to the Executive Risk Committee and the Board Risk Committee.</li> <li>Giving clear, evidence-based challenge to 1st LoD credit, analytics and product teams, and to accountable executives.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Regulatory compliance and engagement</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Making sure credit risk management meets the legal and regulatory requirements of the markets we operate in, including Central Bank of Ireland (CBI) requirements, Irish and European Union law, and European Banking Authority (EBA) and European Central Bank (ECB) guidelines.</li> <li>Leading the 2nd LoD assessment of changing and new credit regulation.</li> <li>Supporting regulatory reporting and engagement, and supporting the Director of Credit Risk on executing their PCF-22 obligations.</li> <li>Acting as a key point of contact for the CBI, internal audit and external auditors on credit risk matters.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Leadership and stakeholder management</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Building the credit risk oversight function from the ground up. You'll start hands-on, then hire and lead a team as the business grows.</li> <li>Putting cutting-edge technology at the heart of how the function works from day one, including generative and agentic artificial intelligence, and making sure we control those tools as carefully as we control everything else.</li> <li>Balancing commercial ambition with rigorous risk boundaries, and helping the business grow safely.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a degree in a quantitative or financial discipline, such as Economics, Econometrics, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance or Financial Engineering. title: Partner Business Development & Sales Manager (m/w/d)
description: Jobbeschreibung Technologie die bewegt. Ein Umfeld, in dem du wachsen kannst. Seit über 20 Jahren gestalten wir bei tecRacer die Cloud-Welt mit. Als führender AWS Premier Tier Services Partner in Deutschland arbeiten wir an anspruchsvollen Cloud-Projekten, entwickeln innovative Lösungen und teilen eine gemeinsame Leidenschaft für Technologie. Was uns dabei mindestens genauso wichtig ist wie technologische Exzellenz? Wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Bei uns zählen gute Ideen mehr als Hierarchien. Wir setzen auf Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und echten Gestaltungsspielraum – und auf ein Umfeld, in dem du dich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst. Klare Karrierepfade, regelmäßiges Feedback, individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und eine transparente Fair-Pay-Struktur schaffen dafür den Rahmen. Gemeinsam liefern, statt in Silos denken. Unsere Projekte verstehen wir als gemeinsame Verantwortung. Deshalb arbeiten unsere Consultants und Developers in einem übergreifenden Delivery Team zusammen: Wissen, Erfahrung und unterschiedliche Perspektiven kommen dort zusammen, wo sie den größten Impact haben. Statt starrer Teamgrenzen setzen wir auf Zusammenarbeit über Projekte und Fachbereiche hinweg. Dabei hast du trotzdem eine feste Führungskraft an deiner Seite, die dich kennt, deine Entwicklung begleitet und gemeinsam mit dir auf deine nächsten Schritte schaut. Über die Stelle Gestalte unser AWS-Partnerökosystem aktiv mit - entwickle gemeinsam mit AWS und unserem Partner-Ökosystem neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und bringe sie erfolgreich zum Abschluss. Dein Fokus liegt dabei besonders auf Net-New- und Greenfield-Kunden im DACH-Raum . Deine Aufgaben Du baust starke Beziehungen zu AWS und weiteren Technologiepartnern auf und entwickelst daraus neue Kunden- und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten. Du identifizierst und qualifizierst partner- und AWS-generierte Opportunities und verantwortest diese vom Erstkontakt bis zum kommerziellen Abschluss. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern Account- und Opportunity-Pläne und treibst Co-Sell-Aktivitäten aktiv voran. Du überführst Partnerkampagnen, Events und gemeinsame Go-to-Market-Aktivitäten in qualifizierte Sales Pipeline. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Pre-Sales, Marketing und Delivery zusammen und sorgst für transparentes Pipeline Management und verlässliche Forecasts . Stellenanforderungen Das solltest du mitbringen: Mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Erfahrung in Partner Sales, Channel Sales, Business Development oder Consultative B2B Sales, idealerweise im IT-, Cloud- oder Technologieumfeld. Erfahrung im Aufbau von Partnerbeziehungen und partnergetriebenen Sales Opportunities , idealerweise mit Technologieanbietern, Solution Providern oder Channel-Partnern. Gutes Verständnis von Co-Sell-, Partner- und Go-to-Market-Modellen sowie Erfahrung mit CRM, Pipeline Management und Forecasting. Eine proaktive, eigenverantwortliche und kommerziell geprägte Arbeitsweise mit klarem Fokus auf Net-New Business. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (C1) sowie Bereitschaft zu ca. 20–30 % Reisetätigkeit Das wäre schön, ist aber kein Muss: Erste praktische Erfahrung mit Partner- oder Channel-Programmen in einem Technologie- oder Consulting-Unternehmen. Erfahrung mit dem AWS-Ökosystem und AWS-Partnerprogrammen . Erste Berührungspunkte mit kommerziellen Partnermodellen, Business Cases, Pricing oder Vertrags- und Verhandlungsthemen. Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, Sales oder einem verwandten Bereich – alternativ ist für uns auch vergleichbare praktische Berufserfahrung relevant. Was dich bei uns erwartet Und weil gute Arbeit mehr braucht als spannende Projekte, schaffen wir Rahmenbedingungen, die zu unterschiedlichen Lebensentwürfen passen. 🚀 Gestaltungsspielraum & Eigenverantwortung - bring deine Ideen ein und gestalte aktiv mit. ☁️ Ein starkes technisches Umfeld - arbeite mit erfahrenen AWS- und Cloud-Expert:innen und lerne voneinander. 📈 Klare Entwicklungsperspektiven - mit Karrierepfaden, regelmäßigem Feedback sowie gezielter fachlicher und persönlicher Weiterentwicklung. 💰 Fair Pay - mit einer transparenten und nachvollziehbaren Vergütungsstruktur. 🕒 Flexible Arbeitszeiten - damit Arbeit und Privatleben gut zusammenpassen. 🏡 Hybrides Arbeiten - mit Flexibilität und gleichzeitig Raum für persönlichen Austausch. 🚆 Deutschland Ticket - für deine berufliche Mobilität. 🚲 JobRad - für alle, die lieber auf zwei Rädern unterwegs sind. 🛡️ Betriebliche Altersvorsorge & Krankenzusatzversicherung - weil Benefits auch langfristig einen Unterschied machen dürfen. 🎉 Regelmäßige Team-Events - für Austausch, gemeinsame Erlebnisse und Zeit miteinander abseits des Projektalltags. title: Personalreferent / HR Generalist (m/w/d)
description: Sie möchten nach Studium oder ersten HR-Erfahrungen den nächsten Karriereschritt gehen und dabei Recruiting, Personalbetreuung und HR-Administration miteinander verbinden? In dieser vielseitigen Position übernehmen Sie früh Verantwortung, begleiten Mitarbeiter:innen und Bewerber:innen entlang des gesamten Employee Lifecycles und entwickeln sich fachlich kontinuierlich weiter. Klingt nach der richtigen Herausforderung? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen! Unser Kunde ist ein international tätiges, wachstumsstarkes Handelsunternehmen mit europäischer Ausrichtung und einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld in der deutsch-niederländischen Grenzregion. Sie erwartet eine moderne Unternehmenskultur mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, direktem Austausch mit Führungskräften und viel Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Aufgaben Sie betreuen Mitarbeiter:innen als Ansprechperson bei unterschiedlichen personalrelevanten Fragestellungen. Sie übernehmen den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess für definierte Unternehmensbereiche – von der Stellenausschreibung über das Bewerber:innen-Screening bis zum Interview und Onboarding. Sie erstellen Arbeitsverträge, Bescheinigungen und Zeugnisse und übernehmen weitere Aufgaben der operativen Personaladministration. Sie pflegen digitale Personalakten und stellen eine strukturierte sowie aktuelle HR-Dokumentation sicher. Sie organisieren Interviews, koordinieren Bewerbungsprozesse und sorgen für eine positive Candidate Experience. Sie vertreten das Unternehmen bei Jobmessen und Recruiting-Veranstaltungen und treten aktiv mit potenziellen Kandidat:innen in Kontakt. Sie unterstützen die interne HR-Kommunikation und sorgen dafür, dass relevante Informationen zuverlässig bei den Mitarbeiter:innen ankommen. Sie planen gemeinsam mit dem HR-Team interne Veranstaltungen und Teambuilding-Aktivitäten. Sie wirken an unterschiedlichen HR-Projekten mit und entwickeln bestehende Personalprozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Qualifikation Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Personalmanagement, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftspsychologie oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Sie bringen erste praktische Erfahrung im Human Resources Management mit, beispielsweise durch eine erste Festanstellung, Praktika oder eine Werkstudententätigkeit. Sie kommunizieren überzeugend und professionell und treten gegenüber Kandidat:innen, Mitarbeiter:innen und Führungskräften sicher auf. Sie arbeiten organisiert, eigenständig und behalten auch bei mehreren parallelen Aufgaben den Überblick. Sie interessieren sich sowohl für Recruiting als auch für die operative Personalbetreuung und Personaladministration. Sie verfügen über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Level) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens B2-Level); Niederländischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Sie arbeiten gerne hands-on und möchten früh Verantwortung für eigene HR-Themen übernehmen. Sie bringen Eigeninitiative, Teamgeist und Freude daran mit, sich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Benefits Sie erhalten Zugang zu attraktiven Stellen, die oft nicht öffentlich ausgeschrieben sind. Sie werden persönlich beraten und während des gesamten Bewerbungsprozesses begleitet. Sie profitieren von ehrlichem Feedback, Diskretion und unserer Branchenexpertise. Sie sparen Zeit, da wir die Kommunikation mit den Unternehmen für Sie übernehmen. Sie erhalten einen niederländischen Arbeitsvertrag und arbeiten in einem internationalen Umfeld in der deutsch-niederländischen Grenzregion. Sie übernehmen bereits ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung für eigene HR-Themen und Projekte. Sie profitieren von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem direkten Austausch mit Führungskräften. Sie erhalten eine vielseitige Einstiegsmöglichkeit mit Entwicklungsperspektive in Recruiting, Personalbetreuung und HR-Administration. Sie arbeiten in einer Vollzeitposition mit einer 45-Stunden-Woche. Sie beginnen Ihren Arbeitstag grundsätzlich ab 8:00 Uhr und arbeiten in festen Arbeitszeitstrukturen. Sie arbeiten vollständig vor Ort; für diese Position ist kein Homeoffice vorgesehen. Sie erhalten 28 Urlaubstage pro Jahr. Sie starten mit einer einmonatigen Probezeit und anschließend zunächst in einem auf 12 Monate befristeten Arbeitsverhältnis mit Perspektive auf eine spätere Entfristung. Sie lernen das Unternehmen zunächst in einem digitalen Erstgespräch und anschließend in einem persönlichen Gespräch vor Ort kennen. Klingt das nach Ihrer nächsten Herausforderung? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt direkt! Wir beurteilen qualifizierte Bewerber:innen ohne Rücksicht auf Geschlecht, Herkunft, Kultur, Mentalität, Alter, Behinderung, Religion und sexuelle Orientierung. title: Senior Product Analyst - Stumble Guys!
description: <p>Are you passionate about using data to shape products played by millions of people around the world? Do you enjoy uncovering player insights, designing experiments, and influencing product decisions with data? If so, we'd love to meet you! </p> <p>We're looking for a <strong>Senior Product Analyst</strong> to help shape the future of <strong>Stumble Guys</strong>, one of the world's leading mobile games. You'll join a team of Product Analysts and Analytics Engineers, partnering closely with Product Managers, Game Designers, Data Engineers, and Developers to turn player behavior into actionable insights.</p> <p>From event instrumentation and data modeling to A/B testing and deep-dive analyses, you'll help answer our most challenging product questions and directly influence the future of the game.</p> <p>If you're excited about working on a game played by millions of daily active users (just ask your younger cousins - they're probably already playing!), we'd love to hear from you! </p> <p>We also work with a modern analytics stack including <strong>Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Looker and Hex.</strong></p> <h3>What You Will Do</h3> <ul> <li>Analyze large and complex datasets to understand the behavior of millions of players and answer strategic product questions.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product, Game Design, Engineering, Marketing, and Leadership to drive data-informed decisions.</li> <li>Design, analyze, and communicate A/B tests to evaluate new features and optimize player experiences.</li> <li>Develop frameworks, dashboards, and analytical tools that empower teams to make better product decisions.</li> <li>Generate actionable insights that improve player engagement, retention, monetization, and overall game performance.</li> <li>Define and validate event tracking to ensure high-quality product analytics.</li> <li>Present findings and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership</li> </ul> <h3>What We're Looking For</h3> <ul> <li>Significant experience working as a <strong>Product Analyst</strong>, ideally in gaming, mobile apps, or other consumer digital products.</li> <li>Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale datasets.</li> <li>Experience with experimentation (A/B testing), product analytics, and statistical analysis.</li> <li>Intellectual curiosity with a passion for solving complex business problems through data.</li> <li>Excellent communication and storytelling skills—you can translate complex analyses into clear recommendations.</li> <li>Python or R experience is a plus.</li> <li>Fluent English, written and spoken.</li> </ul> <p>Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.</p> <p>Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.</p> <p>Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.</p> <p>Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/">https://www.scopely.com/</a>. </p> <p>Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official <a href="http://scopely.com">website</a> and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @<a href="http://scopely.com">scopely.com</a>.</p> <p>Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact ----- Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-ca-residents">California Privacy Notice</a> and <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/eea-and-uk-job-applicant-privacy-notice">EEA/UK Privacy Notice</a>.</p> <p>Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Engineer, Graphics - Unannounced Project
description: <p>We are looking for a <strong>Senior Graphics Engineer</strong> in Ireland, UK, Spain, or Portugal in a hybrid or remote basis. We can support with visa sponsorship from any location.   </p> <p>We are looking for strong rendering expertise and a passion for delivering high-quality, high-performance visuals. weaknesses.</li> <li>Developing prototypes, analysis tools or other technical solutions to investigate security problems.</li> <li>Working with multidisciplinary teams to understand the interaction between security, functionality, safety and system performance.</li> <li>Communicating technical findings clearly to engineers, project teams and customers.</li> </ul> <h5><strong>Domains and project industrial placement, work experience, research or personal projects in at least one or more relevant areas, such as:</li> </ul> <ul data-spread="false"> <li> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>cyber/security engineering</li> <li>software or application development</li> <li>embedded systems</li> <li>computer or network systems</li> <li>electronics or hardware security</li> <li>AI or data science</li> <li>systems engineering</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>The ability to understand and analyse technical systems and identify risks or weaknesses.</li> <li>Some familiarity with security concepts such as authentication, authorisation, cryptography, key management, secure boot, network security and secure development.</li> <li>The ability to read and understand code in languages such as C, C++, Python or Java.</li> <li>Enthusiasm for learning and developing new technical skills.</li> <li>A careful and structured approach to problem solving.</li> <li>Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with others.</li> </ul> <h5><strong>The below is advantageous, but isn’t essential</strong></h5> <ul data-spread="false"> title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Technician
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Technician based in Germany. This is a remote opportunity for a technically skilled AI professional looking to make a tangible impact across business operations. You will research, implement, and optimize AI, automation, and data-driven technologies across multiple functions. The role combines AI/ML expertise with systems integration, process automation, analytics, and operational improvement. You will identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve decision-making, and increase efficiency through technology. You will work with a diverse range of platforms spanning finance, accounting, labor management, forecasting, and business intelligence. The position offers a collaborative, cross-functional environment where innovation and practical problem-solving are highly valued. You will also help teams adopt AI solutions effectively through technical support, training, documentation, and continuous optimization. Accountabilities Research, assess, and recommend emerging AI technologies and automation solutions that can create measurable business value. Deploy and optimize AI models, automation tools, and integrated workflows across different business functions. Integrate and optimize platforms for invoice automation, receipt management, cash-flow forecasting, labor optimization, bookkeeping, and financial reconciliation. Connect POS and accounting systems using integration and automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, or Omnivore. Develop and maintain internal AI-powered dashboards using tools such as Power BI or Looker Studio to provide insights into financial, labor, and operational performance. Streamline financial data flows, including bank transaction imports and accounting processes. Implement and evaluate reconciliation and intelligent bookkeeping solutions to improve accuracy and efficiency. Monitor AI systems and automated workflows, troubleshooting issues and optimizing performance, accuracy, reliability, and scalability. Partner with teams across finance, operations, customer support, marketing, and other functions to embed AI into day-to-day processes. Ensure AI implementations align with relevant industry standards, ethical principles, security considerations, and organizational objectives. Provide technical support, user training, and clear documentation for AI-powered applications and workflows. Track developments in AI, automation, and data technologies and identify opportunities for ongoing innovation and improvement. Requirements: Proven experience working with AI/ML technologies, automation platforms, data processing, or systems integration. Strong technical understanding of AI models, automation workflows, APIs, data flows, and business technology systems. Experience implementing or integrating business applications, ideally across finance, accounting, operations, workforce management, or related functions. Familiarity with tools such as Zapier, Make, Power BI, Looker Studio, or comparable automation and business intelligence platforms. Experience working with accounting, POS, forecasting, reconciliation, or bookkeeping systems is highly valuable. Ability to research emerging technologies, assess their practical applications, and translate business needs into effective technical solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on accuracy, scalability, and measurable outcomes. Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and continuously optimize AI and automation systems. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. A proactive, curious, and innovation-oriented mindset with a strong interest in the evolving AI and automation landscape. Benefits: Remote work / work-from-home flexibility. Health insurance. Additional leave. Opportunities for pay raises. title: Senior Systems Engineer, MCP Server Portals
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal </strong></p> <h2>Role Summary</h2> <p>Cloudflare MCP Server Portals give organizations a secure, centralized way to connect AI agents to internal and third-party tools. As a Senior Systems Engineer on the MCP Portals team, you will lead the design, delivery, and operation of distributed systems that authenticate users, manage OAuth credentials and sessions, enforce Zero Trust policies, and proxy MCP traffic across Cloudflare's global network. You will own complex projects across service boundaries, make architectural tradeoffs for your area, and help other engineers deliver reliable, secure changes. You will work closely with engineers and product managers across Access, Gateway, and Developer Platform teams as the protocol and product evolve. We are looking for a hands-on engineer who can bring clarity to ambiguous systems problems and take responsibility for outcomes in production.</p> <h4> </h4> <h2>Role Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Lead the design, implementation, and operation of globally distributed services that connect MCP clients to authorized upstream MCP servers.</li> <li>Own complex features and service improvements from problem definition and design through implementation, rollout, observability, and production support.</li> <li>Shape technical decisions for MCP Portals, including service boundaries, security controls, compatibility, and tradeoffs among reliability, latency, and resource use.</li> <li>Evolve our implementation as the MCP specification changes, planning safe migrations for existing customers and integrations.</li> <li>Design and review authentication and authorization flows involving Cloudflare Access, OAuth, identity, credential handling, and delegated access to upstream services.</li> <li>Improve the reliability and scalability of multi-tenant systems built on the Cloudflare Developer Platform, using production data to identify and prioritize work.</li> <li>Strengthen observability through structured logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts; participate in production support and incident response.</li> <li>Lead investigations of complex customer issues across services and teams, identify root causes, and drive fixes that prevent recurrence.</li> <li>Review designs and code, mentor engineers, and raise the quality of testing, deployment, and operational practices on the team.</li> <li>Partner with product, security, and engineering teams to turn customer needs and emerging standards into maintainable product capabilities.</li> </ul> <h4> </h4> <h2>Role Requirements</h2> <h3>Must Have Skills</h3> <ul> <li>6+ years of experience building and operating distributed systems, backend services, network services, or infrastructure products in production.</li> <li>Demonstrated ownership of complex production services or projects, including architecture, implementation, rollout, and operational outcomes.</li> <li>Strong programming skills in TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Rust, C++, or another language used to build production services.</li> <li>Deep understanding of HTTP, APIs, proxies, streaming connections, and distributed-systems failure modes.</li> <li>Experience with authentication and authorization technologies such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWTs, PKCE, or policy-based access control.</li> <li>Experience designing or operating security-sensitive systems, with sound judgment about identity, authorization, credential handling, concurrency, and state management.</li> <li>Ability to diagnose difficult production issues using logs, metrics, traces, error reporting, and customer-provided evidence, then drive durable fixes.</li> <li>Experience making backward-compatible changes to live systems and managing the risks of deployment and migration.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs, influence decisions across teams, and mentor other engineers.</li> </ul> <p>Applicants should provide a resume or CV describing relevant engineering, technical leadership, and operational experience.</p> <h3>Nice to Have Skills</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with the Model Context Protocol </li> <li>Familiarity with the Cloudflare Developer Platform or other serverless edge-computing platforms.</li> <li>Experience building gateways, forward proxies, identity systems, developer platforms, or Zero Trust and data loss prevention products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €66,000-91,000 </span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Master Trainer OpenAI (AI & Cloud Partners) (m/w/d), Munich
description: Your mission You train the technical teams of strategic cloud partners to build, integrate and support AI applications with confidence. Your audience is solution architects, field engineers, developers, technical consultants and sales engineering teams. You take a proven AI curriculum and make it work for cloud partner audiences: real deployment scenarios, partner-specific examples, live troubleshooting. You are the technical face of our client in the room. Your tasks include: Deliver instructor-led bootcamps, technical workshops, train-the-trainer sessions and hands-on labs for cloud partner organisations. Adapt core AI training content for partner audiences such as solution architects, field engineers, developers and partner enablement leaders. Translate AI capabilities into practical cloud scenarios, reference architectures and customer-facing use cases. Lead practical exercises on how to build, integrate, deploy, evaluate and support AI applications in cloud environments. Troubleshoot participant issues live, from lab setup and API calls to code samples and implementation questions. Work with program leadership and partner enablement stakeholders to refine delivery plans and localise examples. Keep delivery quality high across regions, cohorts and groups with different technical maturity. Capture recurring knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to content, labs and facilitation guides. Your profile You move comfortably between developer-level detail, cloud architecture context and an executive-friendly explanation. You are energised by teaching complex material and you earn credibility with engineers by knowing your stuff. Experience & Education More than 5 years of professional experience in technical training, developer education, solution architecture, technical consulting, partner engineering, software development or cloud enablement. Experience delivering technical workshops, bootcamps, labs or train-the-trainer sessions for professional audiences. Strong practical fluency with generative AI, LLM concepts, prompt engineering, APIs, SDKs and modern AI application patterns. Hands-on familiarity with cloud platforms and partner environments such as AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure or Oracle Cloud. Fluent English; a second language (French, Spanish or German) is a strong plus. Located in or near a major EMEA city with an airport (for example Munich or Frankfurt). Willingness to travel for partner workshops and regional programs (approx. 25-35%). Of advantage: familiarity with Amazon Bedrock (AWS Bedrock). Of advantage: experience enabling cloud partners, hyperscalers, systems integrators or partner field organisations. Of advantage: experience building hands-on labs, certification pathways or partner academies. Skills & Attributes Explains cloud and AI concepts clearly to engineers, architects and business stakeholders alike. Facilitates live technical labs and solves setup, code and API issues on the spot. Strong executive presence and professional conduct with senior partner stakeholders. Adapts content and communication style to different proficiency levels, regions and roles. Reads, explains and lightly modifies sample code in Python or JavaScript. Understands RAG, vector search, AI agents and workflow orchestration well enough to teach them. Of advantage: experience with developer relations, sales engineering enablement or solution architect training. Why us? You teach AI to the people who bring it to enterprise customers, with a premium learner experience as the standard. Impact: Your sessions build the technical confidence that drives AI adoption across partner field teams in EMEA. Responsibility: You own the delivery quality of your workshops and represent a leading AI company directly with strategic partners. Dynamics: AI products change fast, and so does your content; you work in a small team that decides quickly. Development: Product training and credentialing are provided, and you grow into a specialist role in a new, high-visibility training program. title: R&D Intern - Fairness in Deep Learning - Paris
description: <p><strong>Contexte :</strong></p> <p>Offre de stage de recherche de master d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, débutant en hiver 2026-2027. Ce document liste les possibles directions pour le stage, qui seront ajustées au fil du stage. Le stage aura lieu au sein du centre de recherche d’Artefact à Paris.</p> <p>L’objectif est d'étudier les réseaux de neurones dans un cadre où l’on souhaite garantir l'indépendance des prédictions vis-à-vis d'une variable sensible continue (telle que l'âge, le revenu, la couleur de peau, etc.).</p> <p><strong>Présentation d’Artefact :</strong></p> <p>Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en transformation data, dont la mission est de transformer la donnée  en délivrant des résultats tangibles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des entreprises. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 employés allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit  de l’innovation business des entreprises. Nos technologies de pointe en Intelligence Artificielle, nos méthodes agiles garantissent le succès des projets IA de nos clients, de la conception au déploiement, jusqu’à la formation et l’accompagnement au changement.</p> <p><strong>Sujet :</strong></p> <p>Les réseaux de neurones sont aujourd'hui au cœur de nombreuses applications industrielles. Leur capacité à extraire des représentations riches à partir des données en fait des outils de choix, mais elle les rend aussi susceptibles d'encoder et d'amplifier des biais présents dans les données d'apprentissage, renforçant ainsi des discriminations chez les populations traitées par ces modèles [1]. Cet enjeu est un domaine de recherche dénommé fairness, et est particulièrement dynamique, avec la réglementation des modèles d’IA qui évolue, comme par exemple avec l’AI Act de l’Union Européenne.</p> <p><br>Pour mesurer et mitiger les biais discriminatoires dans les modèles, la littérature s'est majoritairement concentrée sur des variables sensibles binaires ou catégorielles (genre, origine ethnique, etc.), pour lesquelles les groupes sont bien définis [2-5]. Cependant de nombreuses variables sensibles sont intrinsèquement continues : l'âge, le revenu, ou encore la couleur de peau. Discrétiser ces variables en groupes est une pratique courante mais problématique : le choix des seuils est arbitraire, de l'information est perdue, et un modèle peut sembler équitable pour un découpage donné tout en restant fortement biaisé pour un autre [6]. Contrôler la dépendance entre les sorties d'un modèle et une variable continue reste un problème ouvert, notamment pour les réseaux de neurones, où il faut à la fois mesurer cette dépendance et la pénaliser de façon différentiable au cours de l'apprentissage.</p> <p><br>Durant ce stage, le/la stagiaire explorera les méthodes de réduction des biais par rapport à une variable sensible continue pour des réseaux de neurones. Le travail commencera par l'implémentation des méthodes existantes (régularisations basées sur des mesures de dépendance telles que la corrélation maximale de Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi ou “Generalized Disparate Impacte”, etc.), listées dans les références [7-8], et par la mise en place d'un protocole robuste pour les comparer, en tenant compte du compromis entre performance et fairness. Dans un second temps, le stage se concentrera sur la conception et l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de réduction de biais adaptées aux variables continues. Pour cela, le/la stagiaire pourra s'appuyer sur des bibliothèques open source (PyTorch, scikit-learn), afin de rester dans un cadre de code reproductible et facile à adopter.</p> <p><strong>Pré-requis</strong></p> <p>Le profil recherché pour ce poste est le suivant :<br>BAC+4/BAC+5 : Formation en mathématiques appliquées, statistiques ou machine learning au sein d’une université ou école d’ingénieur<br>Stage de césure ou stage de fin d’études<br>Date de début : Hiver 2026-2027<br>Durée : 4 à 6 mois</p> <p><strong>Références</strong></p> <ol> <li>Risser, L., Sanz, A. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.</p></div><p data-pm-slice="1 3 []"><strong>About the Engineering team </strong><br>The Engineering team builds systems that power Affirm’s mission. business, including large-scale redesigns and structural improvements to the identity verification journey.</p> </li> <li> <p>You will empower your tech lead and engineers to hold the design and quality bar, supporting them hands-on throughout technical design and cross-functional alignment.</p> </li> <li> <p>You will own the availability, reliability, and performance of consumer-critical systems – on-call, incident response, and reducing operational toil.</p> </li> <li> <p>You will drive alignment across multiple organizations and influence roadmaps on partner experience and foundational teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>You will partner across Product, Design, and Analytics, and other Engineering teams, building trust and taking part in cross-functional efforts.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we look for</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>You have 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years managing and growing engineering teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>You have proven experience delivering consumer-facing software and driving execution through ambiguity.</p> </li> <li> <p>You have the technical judgment required to guide architecture, quality, and reliability decisions, with the instinct to empower senior engineers to make the calls rather than making them all yourself.</p> </li> <li> <p>You have experience leading significant technical initiatives end-to-end, ideally decoupling or re-platforming consumer-facing systems within clear time constraints.</p> </li> <li> <p>You have a calm, decisive presence through change and ambiguity – building alignment, resolving tensions, and leading others through complex decisions.</p> </li> <li> <p>You are a humble, team-first leader who builds a high-trust, psychologically safe culture, while also prioritizing your own growth.</p> </li> <li> <p>You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints.</p> </li> <li> <p>You exhibit exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organizational influence skills.</p> </li> <li> <p>You have a proven ability to build alignment and drive outcomes in complex environments without direct authority.</p> </li> <li> <p>This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.<br><br></p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation & Benefits</strong></h3> <p>Base Pay Grade - P</p> <p>Equity Grade - 7</p> <p>Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.</p> <p>Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidised medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)</p> <p>Base pay range per year: <strong>£142,000 - £190,000</strong></p> <p>Location: UK Remote</p> <p><strong> #LI-Remote</strong></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><strong>Remote-first with flexibility built in</strong><strong><br></strong>Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.</p> <p><strong>Benefits designed for you</strong><strong><br></strong>Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:</p> <ul> <li>Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.</li> <li>Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.</li> <li>Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.</li> <li>Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.</li> </ul> <p>We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.</p> <p>For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.</p> </div> <div> <p>By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's <a href="https://www.affirm.com/global-candidate-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Global Candidate Privacy Notice</a> and consent to the use of your personal information as described.</p> </div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Research Scientist- Interactive Avatars
description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. About the role As a Staff Research Scientist, you will join a team of 40+ researchers and engineers in our R&D department, working on the frontier of generative AI with a focus on avatar-centric, interactive video diffusion models. This is a unique opportunity for experts in machine learning and diffusion models to shape the future of AI video agents that listen, respond, and react like humans. As part of our Interactive Avatars team, you'll build models that hold natural, real-time conversations: understanding what a user says and how they say it, then responding with appropriate turn-taking, backchannels, gaze, and facial and body reactions. You'll join a team that moves fast, iterates often, and turns breakthrough research into product capabilities that ship. What you'll do Set the research direction and roadmap for dyadic interaction modeling, balancing long-term bets with near-term product impact. Advance the state of the art in the perceptual layer of interactive agents, including understanding user audio and video and generating contextually appropriate reactions. Post-train multimodal models to generate rich, natural dyadic interactions from user audio and video inputs. Adapt diffusion models to new conditioning signals, such as conversational state, turn-taking, and listener cues. Build robust evaluation frameworks and test suites for continuous tracking of interaction quality. Partner with our data team to define data needs and shape high-quality datasets. Lead and mentor a small group of researchers, and drive technical decisions across research, data, and engineering. What we're looking for: Deep ML expertise and extensive hands-on experience with diffusion models, ideally for video or avatar generation. A strong publication record at top-tier venues (e.g., CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, SIGGRAPH) in areas such as world models, dyadic interaction, or video diffusion, or equivalent demonstrated impact. Experience leading a small team of researchers and mentoring junior members. A track record of taking research from idea to production. title: Senior Legal Counsel Carbon Markets
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 4">About<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></span><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 4">Carbonfuture</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134245418":true,"134245529":true,"201341983":0,"335559738":40,"335559739":0,"335559740":259}"> </span></p> <p>Carbonfuture provides the trust infrastructure that helps organizations meet their net-zero commitments and gets climate action financed at scale. Our digital infrastructure makes carbon removal credits traceable, enforceable, and trustworthy, so suppliers, buyers, and financial institutions can transact with confidence.</p> <p>Today, we are the global market leader by facilitated carbon removal sales volume, working with some of the most ambitious companies in the market, including Microsoft, Swiss Re, and SAP.  We are backed by SIX, operator of the Swiss and Spanish stock exchanges, as a strategic investor and partner, and operate from our headquarters in Freiburg, Germany (Carbonfuture GmbH), where contracts are governed under German law. We also have subsidiaries in Switzerland and the US.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span class="TextRun MacChromeBold SCXW140738050 BCX8" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW140738050 BCX8">Your Role</span></span></span></strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our goal is to turn carbon credits into a new financial asset class and provide the settlement infrastructure. This requires governance frameworks for our digital infrastructure, standardised contracts for an evolving asset class and enforceable rules that financial institutions, regulators and customers can rely on, and Carbonfuture is writing many of them. The liability and risk landscape is largely unmapped: this is genuinely novel work where the legal groundwork you establish will set standards in an emerging industry.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our contracting parties span between project developers who are removing CO2 out of the atmosphere with frontier technologies as well as the biggest corporates worldwide (including SAP, Microsoft, Swiss Re) purchasing carbon credits from us.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We're looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to lead that work. title: Product Manager, AI Driver
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Product Team Our Product team works at the intersection of AI research, engineering and customer needs to shape the future of autonomous driving at Wayve. We define product direction, translate complex technical capabilities into clear roadmaps, and bring cross-functional teams together to turn research into products that deliver real-world impact. Working closely with engineers, researchers, programme managers and automotive partners, we balance long-term ambition with practical delivery. We combine technical depth with product judgement, listen carefully to our customers and teams, and create alignment around what to build, why it matters and how we’ll measure success. 🧠 Your day-to-day Lead a cross-functional team of engineers, researchers and PMs without formal authority. Give them clarity, remove blockers, and motivate them through hard, ambiguous problems. Engage deeply with technical detail across AI / ML, autonomy and embodied AI. Debate trade-offs credibly with senior researchers and engineers, and bring structured thinking to complex technical decisions. Communicate crisply across audiences, from deep technical reviews with engineers, to executive updates with leadership, to customer-facing conversations. Listen actively to engineers, partners and customers, and turn what you hear into better decisions and stronger team alignment. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Independently own a substantial work package end-to-end. Define the problem, set the strategy, sequence the work, and lead the team to ship outcomes that move the AI Driver product forward. Translate R&D progress and customer needs into a clear product roadmap, sequencing capabilities to maximise impact and de-risk delivery. Set, track and report on clear KPIs and milestones, and establish the operating rhythm the team needs to deliver. 🙌 You should apply if: You’ve independently owned a substantial work package and led a cross-functional team to deliver it. You take responsibility for outcomes and proactively work through blockers. You bring strong technical depth, ideally in AI/ML, autonomy, robotics or another deep-tech domain, and can engage credibly with senior engineers and researchers. You’re a careful listener and clear communicator who can motivate and energise a team through ambiguity. You have a proven track record in product management, technical programme management or a similar role working on complex, cutting-edge technical products. You work autonomously, exercise sound judgement and are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, then adapting as you learn. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency Interviews (Product Sense interview; 1 hour) Deep-dive technical interviews (Cross-functional, domain-specific interview, presentation; 2.5 hours total) Final interview : mission & values alignment (1 hour). We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory. title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. This is not a typical BDR seat. It is the chance to build our enterprise go-to-market from zero. Enterprises want to deploy humanoids. Your job is to find them, reach them first, and bring them in. The market, the outreach, and the first conversation are yours to build. What You Will Do Own outreach and first contact. Bring the enterprises that want to deploy humanoids to us. Generate and qualify leads across enterprise accounts. Own one or more markets end to end. Your territory, your pipeline, your number. Continuously improve how we reach enterprise companies. New channels, new angles, kill what does not work. Book qualified meetings and hand over the context to close. Requirements A track record of excellence, wherever you earned it: a top-tier VC, a startup, or a company you built yourself. Willing to get your hands dirty. You build the lists, write the emails, and chase the follow-ups yourself. High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. Fluent in two languages. Based in Munich, in the office. Nice to Have A strong academic background. We care more about what you have done than where you studied. Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits: Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it. Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it. Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them. Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes. This is for you if: You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec. You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one. You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do. This is not for you if: You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5. You would forward output you cannot explain. "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer. How We Hire We read every application and reply within five working days. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem. Then a decision, usually within a few days. Pay Transparency Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting. What We Offer Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter. Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval. A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage. Free food and drinks in the office. Equal Opportunity MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone.
