title: Enterprise Account Executive, FSI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As an Enterprise Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll join the foundational team at the forefront of introducing our cutting-edge AI productivity API and SaaS solutions to financial institutions across the EMEA markets. You'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic deals with banks, insurance companies, and financial research institutions. You'll leverage your consultative sales expertise in the financial services sector to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to financial stakeholders, helping them embed and deploy AI while uncovering its full range of capabilities in banking, research, and administration. In collaboration with GTM, Product, and Marketing teams, you'll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to resonate with financial decision-makers.</p> <p>The ideal candidate will have a passion for developing new market segments, pinpointing high-potential opportunities, and executing strategies to capture them. By driving deployment of Anthropic's emerging products, you will help enterprises obtain new capabilities while also advancing the ethical development of AI.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Win new business and drive revenue for Anthropic within the financial services sector. Navigate complex financial institutions to reach key decision-makers, educate them about our services, and help them succeed with Anthropic. You'll own the full sales cycle, from first outbound to close</li> <li>Design and execute innovative sales strategies tailored to financial services procurement cycles and budgeting processes to meet and exceed revenue quotas. Analyze financial market landscapes, trends, and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activities and campaigns</li> <li>Spearhead market expansion by identifying new use cases within financial departments, research centers, and administrative offices. Collaborate cross-functionally to differentiate our offerings for financial applications</li> <li>Navigate complex financial stakeholder ecosystems including executives, administrators, IT departments, and procurement offices to build consensus</li> <li>Inform product roadmaps and features by gathering feedback from financial users and conveying financial market needs. Provide insights that strengthen our value proposition for financial services</li> <li>Continuously refine the financial services sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices. Identify process improvements that optimize sales productivity and consistency</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You may be a good fit if you have:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>12+ years of B2B sales experience in financial services technology in SaaS, API solutions, or emerging technologies</li> <li>A track record of managing complex sales cycles within financial institutions and securing strategic deals by understanding both technical requirements and financial use cases</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to navigate financial bureaucracies and procurement processes, building consensus among diverse stakeholders including executives, administrators, and IT departments </li> <li>Extensive experience negotiating complex agreements within financial services procurement frameworks and policies</li> <li>Proven experience exceeding revenue targets in the financial services sector by effectively managing an evolving pipeline and sales process</li> <li>Excellent communication skills and the ability to present confidently to various financial audiences, from analysts and researchers to senior executives</li> <li>Deep understanding of financial services buying cycles, decision-making processes, and key pain points</li> <li>A strategic, analytical approach to assessing the financial services market combined with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities</li> <li>A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems and their applications in financial services. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely and ethically for financial use</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>À propos du poste</strong></h2> <p>En tant qu'Enterprise Account Executive chez Anthropic, vous rejoindrez l'équipe fondatrice chargée de faire découvrir notre API de productivité IA de pointe et nos solutions SaaS aux institutions financières des marchés EMEA. Vous favoriserez l'adoption d'une IA de pointe et sûre en concluant des contrats stratégiques avec des banques, des compagnies d'assurance et des instituts de recherche financière. Vous mettrez à profit votre expertise de la vente consultative dans les services financiers pour accélérer la croissance du chiffre d'affaires. Vous nouerez aussi des relations de confiance avec les parties prenantes du secteur financier et les aiderez à intégrer et à déployer l'IA, tout en leur faisant découvrir l'étendue de ses capacités dans la banque, la recherche et l'administration. En collaboration avec les équipes GTM, Produit et Marketing, vous affinerez en continu notre proposition de valeur, notre méthodologie de vente et notre positionnement, afin qu'ils trouvent un écho auprès des instances décisionnelles du secteur financier.</p> <p>Le profil idéal a à cœur de développer de nouveaux segments de marché, de repérer les opportunités à fort potentiel et de mettre en œuvre les stratégies qui permettent de les saisir. En favorisant le déploiement des produits émergents d'Anthropic, vous aiderez les entreprises à acquérir de nouvelles capacités tout en contribuant au développement éthique de l'IA.</p> <h2><strong>Responsabilités :</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Remporter de nouveaux contrats et générer du chiffre d'affaires pour Anthropic dans le secteur des services financiers. Vous orienter au sein d'institutions financières complexes pour atteindre les personnes décisionnaires clés, leur présenter nos services et les aider à réussir avec Anthropic. Vous piloterez l'intégralité du cycle de vente, de la première prise de contact à la signature.</li> <li>Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies commerciales innovantes, adaptées aux cycles d'achat et aux processus budgétaires des services financiers, afin d'atteindre et de dépasser les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires. Analyser le paysage, les tendances et les dynamiques des marchés financiers pour traduire les plans stratégiques en actions et campagnes commerciales ciblées.</li> <li>Piloter l'expansion sur le marché en identifiant de nouveaux cas d'usage au sein des directions financières, des centres de recherche et des services administratifs. Collaborer de manière transverse pour différencier nos offres destinées aux applications financières.</li> <li>Naviguer dans des écosystèmes complexes de parties prenantes (direction générale, services administratifs, DSI et services achats) afin de construire un consensus.</li> <li>Contribuer à la feuille de route et aux fonctionnalités produit en recueillant les retours des équipes utilisatrices du secteur financier et en relayant les besoins du marché. Apporter des éclairages qui renforcent notre proposition de valeur pour les services financiers.</li> <li>Affiner en continu la méthodologie de vente dédiée aux services financiers en intégrant les enseignements dans des playbooks, des modèles et des bonnes pratiques. Identifier des améliorations de processus qui optimisent la productivité et la cohérence commerciales.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Ce poste pourrait vous correspondre si vous avez :</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Au moins 12 ans d'expérience en vente B2B dans les technologies pour les services financiers (SaaS, solutions API ou technologies émergentes)</li> <li>Une solide expérience de la gestion de cycles de vente complexes au sein d'institutions financières et de la conclusion de contrats stratégiques, fondée sur une compréhension fine des exigences techniques comme des cas d'usage financiers</li> <li>Une capacité avérée à naviguer dans les structures bureaucratiques et les processus d'achat du secteur financier, en construisant un consensus entre des parties prenantes variées, dont la direction, les services administratifs et les DSI</li> <li>Une vaste expérience de la négociation d'accords complexes dans le cadre des politiques et procédures d'achat des services financiers</li> <li>Une expérience confirmée du dépassement des objectifs de chiffre d'affaires dans les services financiers, grâce à une gestion efficace d'un pipeline et d'un processus de vente en constante évolution</li> <li>D'excellentes compétences en communication et l'aisance nécessaire pour présenter devant des publics financiers variés, des analystes et des équipes de recherche jusqu'aux membres de la direction</li> <li>Une connaissance approfondie des cycles d'achat, des processus de décision et des principales problématiques du secteur des services financiers</li> <li>Une approche stratégique et analytique du marché des services financiers, alliée à une exécution tactique et créative pour saisir les opportunités</li> <li>Un intérêt marqué pour les systèmes d'IA avancés et leurs applications dans les services financiers, voire une expérience dans ce domaine. Le développement sûr et éthique des systèmes d'IA de pointe pour les usages financiers vous tient particulièrement à cœur.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study: </strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. title: M&A & Equity Financing Legal Counsel
description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. Role Summary As our M&A & Equity Financing Legal Counsel , you will work directly under the Head of M&A and Finance Legal Counsel, based in Paris. In close collaboration with our Business and Finance teams, you will play a key role in structuring, drafting and negotiating Mistral’s external growth transactions and equity fundraisings. Mistral operates at the frontier of AI, where the pace of innovation demands transaction execution speed and precision that match the technology itself. You will help shape the growth and business relationships that will define Mistral’s next chapter. Key responsibilities Draft, negotiate and advise on a wide range of M&A transactions, including acquisitions, acqui-hires and other internal or external growth projects worldwide. Take an active part in every stage of M&A transactions: deal structuring, due diligence, negotiations, signing and closing. Coordinate the process for Mistral’s equity fundraisings, including legal communication with prospective investors, structuring the company's due diligence disclosure, drafting investment documentation and leading the signing and closing of equity fundraisings. Coordinate and assist on Mistral’s secondary sale transactions on behalf of investors and employees. Draft, negotiate, and advise on transaction documentation, including LOIs, NDAs, SPAs, shareholders' agreements, investment agreements, and other ancillary transaction documents. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including other corporate functions. Build internal templates, practices, and guidelines for M&A and equity financing documentation. Support on other legal topics as needed, particularly on compliance matters related to corporate affairs. Qualifications and skills Bachelor's degree or above (LLB, LLM or Juris Doctor preferred) from an accredited law school in France or another EU country. Admission to practice law in at least one additional jurisdiction, in particular the USA or the UK, would be a plus. A minimum of 4–5 years of relevant legal experience, including at least 3 years at an international law firm. Substantial experience in M&A, VC and/or equity financing transactions, including hands-on experience working on large- to mid-cap acquisitions, from due diligence through signing and closing. Familiarity with VC/PE-type transaction documentation is highly valued: you understand complex shareholders’ agreements, management and employee incentive packages, as well as the governance dynamics of venture-backed and PE-backed companies. Excellent written and verbal communication in both English and French, with a strong ability to present complex legal concepts clearly to non-legal stakeholders. Knowledge and understanding of artificial intelligence technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing and their applications. Adaptability: proactive, flexible, eager to learn and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Ethical awareness: a strong understanding of ethical considerations related to AI, such as fairness, transparency, accountability, and bias mitigation. What We Offer We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page . Privacy Policy Your privacy matters to us. description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. The mission You will be the reference point for the most complex hardware interventions across our sites. Mistral's compute is our largest investment and the foundation of frontier AI in Europe. As a Senior Data Center Hardware Engineer (L4-L5) , you own the interventions that require the highest level of technical expertise: multi-node failures in production, full-rack deployments of GPU-dense systems, and vendor escalations where you speak as the technical authority for our sites. You'll work end-to-end — compute, storage, interconnect, power and cooling interfaces — across our data center footprint, raising the bar on reliability as our capacity grows. This is a hands-on senior IC role: deep technical leadership and mentorship, no direct line management. Location: Based at one of our data centers in the Paris region, with occasional visits to our other sites as needed. What you'll do Lead complex interventions — vendor-level and multi-node operations in production: full rack builds and bring-up, GPU-dense platform deployment (H100/H200-class and next-gen, including liquid-cooled racks), intricate recabling, post-restart diagnosis. You own the plan, the risk assessment, and the rollback. Own vendor management — coordinate repairs, part replacements and escalations directly with hardware vendors; hold them to their SLAs; drive proactive fixes from failure trends. Diagnose at depth — correlate symptoms across compute, storage, interconnect and cooling; read BMC/IPMI consoles, OS logs and crash dumps; methodical root-cause analysis that ends in concrete corrective actions. Deploy and validate — structured bring-up and validation of new racks and platforms; work with networking and infrastructure teams to take installations from delivery to production-ready. Lift the team — mentor and pair with L1–L3 engineers on live operations; turn your knowledge into SOPs, checklists and training material; propose and build small automation (Python/Bash) to shorten MTTR. Work the facility interface — partner with critical facilities/engineering ops on power, cooling (air and liquid), PDU and monitoring (BMS/EPMS) boundaries; enforce ESD/LOTO/PPE and audit-ready change discipline everywhere. Own spares & reliability — plan spares strategy, track fleet failure trends, and run proactive vendor actions before incidents happen. About you 6+ years in data center / server hardware or L2/L3 hardware support, including complex hands-on work in production environments (HPC/AI/cloud at scale strongly preferred). End-to-end hardware expertise: CPU/memory/PCIe (incl. accelerators), NICs, PSUs, drives, network, power and cooling interfaces (DLC included); strong judgment on when and how to escalate. Diagnostics depth: confident with BMC/IPMI logs, Linux logs and CLI checks; structured root-cause analysis. Deployment experience: you've taken racks from delivery to production, with concrete examples to show for it. Vendor fluency: you've managed hardware vendors — RMAs, field replacements, escalations — to concrete outcomes. Impeccable safety and discipline: ESD/LOTO/PPE without exception; clean, labeled, auditable work. Communication & mentoring: clear status updates and handovers; able to coach engineers during live incidents with composure. Mobility: willing to visit our other sites in the Paris region as needed. Nice to have GPU-dense platform experience: NVIDIA H-series (H100/H200) or GB-series rack deployments. High-speed interconnects (InfiniBand/RoCE), RAID/storage (NVMe/SAS/SATA), vendor tooling (iDRAC/iLO/IPMI). title: LLM Scientist, AI for Science
description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. About the Role We are hiring an LLM Scientist to push the boundaries of AI-driven scientific discovery. You will specialize in developing and optimizing large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, and deep learning frameworks to solve open problems in the natural sciences: Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and/or Materials Science. Your work will empower scientists with cutting-edge AI tools and accelerate research through: Model-centric innovation : Improving LLMs’ capabilities to tackle complex scientific problems (e.g., literature synthesis, autonomous experimentation, rigorous derivations). Cross-disciplinary collaboration : Partnering with Natural sciences domain experts to translate AI advancements into real-world scientific impact. What you will do AI/ML Research : Participate in end-to-end training of LLM-based solutions, with a focus on scalability, generalization, and scientific applicability . Data creation : Design original workflows to accumulate high quality scientific data at scale, either through synthetic or crowd sourced pipelines. Algorithm Design : Use and improve reinforcement learning, or agentic systems tailored to Natural sciences challenges (e.g., modeling resolution, material property prediction, advanced data analysis and coding). Interdisciplinary Bridge : Work closely with domain scientists to identify AI opportunities and refine models based on feedback. Tooling & Infrastructure : Contribute to company infrastructure to improve usability for model training in scientific contexts and open-source AI tools for science for non-AI experts. Autonomous Innovation : Set a research agenda for AI in science, exploring high-risk/high-reward ideas. What We're Are Looking For AI/ML Expertise : Strong background in LLMs, deep learning, or agentic AI , with a track record of applying these to real-world problems (publications, open-source contributions, or deployed systems) – at the minimum extensive experience in computer science and ideally experience scaling synthetic data generation. State-of-the-art Knowledge : Familiarity with the latest advancements in LLM architectures and post training. Technical Depth : Hands-on experience with PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX , model optimization, and scaling techniques (e.g., fine-tuning, RLHF). Scientific Capability : Ability to understand 1 Natural Science domain at a high level (e.g., graduate level specialization + general undergrad knowledge) to design effective AI solutions. Engineering Rigor : Proficiency in scientific computing (e.g., numerical methods, HPC) and software best practices. Collaboration : Experience translating technical AI concepts for non-experts (e.g., scientists, engineers) and iterating based on user needs. Mindset : Low ego, team player, and eager to tackle operational challenges (e.g., data pipelines, model deployment). Motivational paragraph When applying for the AI for Science team at Mistral, please describe in a short paragraph a potential project that you would like to contribute to the team, why it is challenging and interesting in general, and more specifically for Mistral. Please also highlight the specific skill set that you can bring to the team. What We Offer We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page . Privacy Policy Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy . Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
description: Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. Deine Rolle bei June Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche. Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. Anforderungen Was du mitbringst Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. Das wäre ein Plus Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. So arbeiten wir Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite. Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap. Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege. Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess. Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten. Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort. Hinweis: Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Manager/ Associate Director, Financial Advisory
description: <h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p>This is an excellent opportunity to work alongside our established team who will support you to utilise and enhance your advisory and insolvency skills and experience. You will work alongside some of the most experienced practitioners in the field advising the boards, management teams, lenders and shareholders of companies which are underperforming and/or facing any financial stress. </p> <p>Our North team has recently led a number of high profile regional insolvencies (including the Black Sheep Brewery, WN VTech and TXM Plant Administrations), as well as working on complex and challenging advisory assignments  We work with a full spectrum of companies from SME to PLC.</p> <p>As a Manager / Associate Director in the team, you will have the opportunity to work and lead on a diverse range of engagements across all sectors, with plenty of responsibility for leading workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting Directors and Senior Managing Directors in client-facing delivery. </p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <p><strong>Client service</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage parts of the engagement, including managing junior staff and providing support to the Senior Managing Director/ Director in managing external stakeholders.</li> <li>Providing comprehensive financial restructuring and cash management services to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.</li> <li>Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach.</li> <li>Develop, analyse and present Financial Advisory options using input from other teams, e.g. tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.</li> <li>Produce high quality deliverables within planned timescales.</li> <li>Liaise with the company’s / lender’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation, insolvency sale and trading agreements etc.)</li> <li>Developing and inputting into insolvency strategies.</li> <li>Delivering key aspects of insolvency assignments including trading, sales process, asset realisations, monitoring, reporting and liaising with the insolvency delivery team to ensure all statutory compliance completed.</li> <li>Apply an understanding of engagement economics, financial and risk management.</li> <li>Develops and maintains their own ‘distinctive’ client relationships.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Knowledge acquisition</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.</li> <li>Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.</li> <li>Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>People and leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support practice and talent development.</li> <li>Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.</li> <li>Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.</li> <li>Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.</li> <li>Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Business development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Start to own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Director/ Senior Managing Director-led marketing and sales activities.</li> <li>Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.</li> <li>Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.</li> <li>Take sector focus responsibilities.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Key Skills & Experience</strong></h2> <p><strong>Basic Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Qualified accountant (ACA/ACCA or equivalent), both time and exam qualified.</li> <li>Restructuring experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or bank.</li> <li>Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.</li> <li>Good understanding of the restructuring marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).</li> <li>Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.</li> <li>An understanding of insolvency legislation and practice, with experience working on insolvency assignments.</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Strong project management skills, with ability to lead teams and develop people.</li> <li>Ability to conduct business in fluent oral and written English is a pre-requisite.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>The Financial Advisory Team at Teneo</strong></h2> <p>Our global Financial Advisory business advises corporates, creditors and other financial stakeholders in all situations – from well-performing to stressed. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client.  </p> <p>Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, turnaround or exit underperforming businesses, assess options, address balance sheet stress, communicate appropriately with all stakeholders, more efficiently run their businesses and, ultimately, deliver certainty from uncertainty. </p> <p>Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in establishing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>What can we offer you?</strong></h2> <p>New joiners are supported by an induction programme. As well as this we offer a whole host of benefits and reward including:</p> <ul> <li>Market-leading Salary</li> <li>25 days holiday (plus an additional 3 days holiday over Christmas and one day to celebrate DE&I)</li> <li>Discretionary Bonus Scheme</li> <li>Cash benefits package</li> <li>Extensive investment in personal development & learning</li> <li>Enhanced maternity and paternity leave (depending on length of service) and shared parental leave</li> <li>Group Income Protection </li> <li>Life Assurance</li> <li>Cycle to work schemes</li> <li>Regular social, cultural and charitable activities</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About Teneo</strong></h2> <p></p> <p>Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.</p> <p>Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other cor­po­ra­tions, financial insti­tu­tions and organisations.</p> <p>Our full range of advisory services includes strategic com­mu­ni­ca­tions, investor relations, financial trans­ac­tions and restruc­tur­ing, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, orga­ni­sa­tion­al design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance and ESG.</p> <p>The firm has more than 1,800 employees located in 50+ offices around the world.</p> <p></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Unsere Expertise liegt im Digitalen Maschinenbau und wir beschäftigen uns insbesondere mit der digitalen Auslegung und Herstellung automatisierter Zuführlösungen. In 2021 erfolgte der Anschluss des Startups an den Weltmarktführer in der Zuführtechnik, der Rhein-Nadel-Automation GmbH. Unser Fokus liegt zu 100% auf der Softwareentwicklung. Unsere Software-Teams verteilen sich auf die Standorte München und Aachen. In München entwickeln wir unsere Dienste für Künstliche Intelligenz und Simulation. In Aachen nutzen wir die Nähe zum Shop Floor für Sonder-Digitalisierungsprojekte und Shop Floor-bezogene Software. Die Kombination von jahrzehntelanger Erfahrung im Bereich Zuführtechnik gepaart mit modernsten Technologien im Bereich der künstlichen Intelligenz ermöglicht es uns, die Zuführtechnik von Morgen zu entwickeln. Zur Verstärkung unseres Entwicklungsteams suchen wir einen erfahrenen Fullstack Software Engineer (m/w/d) mit Sitz im Raum München. Die Arbeit erfolgt größtenteils mobil, jedoch ist eine regelmäßige Anwesenheit im Office in München vorgesehen (ca. 1 Mal pro Woche). Deine Aufgaben Entwicklung: Du treibst zusammen mit dem Team den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung interner Apps zur Prozessdigitalisierung und -automatisierung voran. Die React-basierten Apps kommunizieren über REST mit verschiedenen Django-Backends/-Microservices. Die containerbasierte Architektur umfasst auch KI-/ML-Module sowie automatisierte Physik-Simulationen. Aufgabenspektrum: Du wirkst von der Anforderungsaufnahme über die Implementierung bis zur Auslieferung mit. Schnittstellen: Du arbeitest in einem dynamischen Umfeld und stehst im engen Kontakt mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen, um Nutzeranforderungen zu verstehen und umzusetzen. Dein Profil Ausbildung: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem MINT-Fach oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Berufserfahrung: Du hast mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung/Webentwicklung. Soft-skills: Dich zeichnen deine Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsstärke und Durchsetzungsvermögen aus. Arbeitsweise: Du verfügst über eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative. Sprachkenntnisse: Du kannst dich fließend auf Deutsch (mind. C1) und Englisch verständigen. Für die Aufgabe sind folgende Toolkenntnisse notwendig: - Fundierte Kenntnisse in: Python/Django (oder andere ORM-Tools oder fundierte SQL-Erfahrung) Javascript/React (oder ähnliche Frontend-Frameworks) - Wünschenswert : Docker ERP-Kenntnisse Warum wir? Hohe Gestaltungsfreiheit und Flexibilität im Zukunftsthema Digitaler Maschinenbau Flache Hiararchie und Startup-Spirit Idealer Mix aus mobilem Arbeiten und Office-Präsenz Corporate Benefits: Urban Sports Club, Coffee Bar & Snacks, Team Events Ein großartiges internationales Team , das nicht nur am Arbeitsplatz Höchstleistung erbringt, sondern auch bei gemeinsamen Events 30 Tage Jahresurlaub Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
description: Description We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join us? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors. Let’s make the invisible visible! What will you do Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements. Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months. Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team. Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements. For each requirement, define acceptance criteria from the customer's point of view so it is clear and testable when the need is met, and link them to customer evaluation and qualification plans. Align with the Product Development department on scope and timing, and hand solution-neutral requirements into engineering: state the need and the why, and leave the how to the disciplines. Support go-to-market: give input on positioning, pricing, launch readiness, and documentation scope together with the applications, operations, and product development teams. What is expected of you Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment. A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from. The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them. Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software. Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning. We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree; a technical or scientific background is typical. The working language is English. Additional experience we value: Semiconductor industry knowledge (fabs, IDMs, OSATs, inspection, metrology, or failure analysis). Familiarity with SEMI standards and fab tool integration (for example, S2/S8, E10, SECS/GEM). Experience selecting or setting up a requirements management tool (for example, Jama, Polarion, or CodeBeamer). A working understanding of quantum sensing, optics, or precision instrumentation. Our benefits Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual. Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast. Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active. Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment. Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired. Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills. Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
description: <h2><strong>Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)</strong></h2> <h2><strong>The opportunity</strong></h2> <p>Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly <strong>3,000 people</strong> work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced.</p> <p>More than <strong>500,000 healthcare professionals</strong> use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately <strong>90 million people</strong> across Europe.</p> <p>For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an <strong>AI-powered Health Companion</strong> that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.</p> <p>This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.</p> <p>We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.</p> <h2><strong>What you will build and lead</strong></h2> <p>As <strong>Product Design Director, Patient</strong>, you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams. </p> <p>Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including:</p> <ul> <li>access to care, search and booking;</li> <li>patient messaging and teleconsultation;</li> <li>the Patient Health Record and patient context;</li> <li>the app homepage and daily health experience;</li> <li>health content and prevention;</li> <li>recommendations, reminders and care plans;</li> <li>new patient services and subscription experiences;</li> <li>conversational and AI-powered experiences.</li> </ul> <p>The current team includes <strong>six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer</strong>. You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.</p> <h2><strong>Your mandate</strong></h2> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li>Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey.</li> <li>Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.</li> <li>Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.</li> <li>Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.</li> <li>Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.</li> <li>Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.</li> <li>Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.</li> <li>Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business.</li> <li>Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts.</li> <li>Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2> <p>In your first year, you will have:</p> <ul> <li>established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream;</li> <li>raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences;</li> <li>helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences;</li> <li>strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical;</li> <li>developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;</li> <li>helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we are looking for</strong></h2> <p>You are likely to bring:</p> <ul> <li>Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership..</li> <li>Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people.</li> <li>A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance.</li> <li>Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers.</li> <li>Strong product design craft and creative judgement. You can recognise excellent work, make difficult quality trade-offs and stay close enough to the details to raise the standard of the product.</li> <li>Experience connecting design choices to measurable outcomes such as adoption, conversion, engagement, retention, satisfaction or user behaviour.</li> <li>A strong and practical understanding of AI-native product experiences. You have thought deeply about how AI changes interaction design, user expectations, trust, transparency and control.</li> <li>Experience designing with uncertainty, recommendations, personalisation or conversational interfaces is highly relevant.</li> <li>The ability to operate across complex products and stakeholders, while maintaining clarity and momentum.</li> <li>A concise and compelling communication style. You can articulate a clear point of view, align senior stakeholders and inspire teams to move in a new direction.</li> <li>Experience in healthcare or another regulated, trust-sensitive environment is valuable, but healthcare experience is not required. What matters is your respect for domain expertise and your ability to design responsibly in high-stakes contexts.</li> <li>Fluency in English. French or German would be a strong plus.</li> <li>A working style aligned with the Doctolib Playbook: User First, Medical Expertise, Forefront of Innovation, Bold, Drive, Passion, Humility.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why Doctolib, why now?</strong></h2> <p>Doctolib gives you the opportunity to work on a consumer product with significant reach, strong European scale and a mission that matters.</p> <p>The patient product already has a large and engaged audience. The next challenge is to make the experience more useful, more contextual and more present in people’s everyday health journeys.</p> <p>You will join at a defining moment:</p> <ul> <li>Doctolib is moving from appointment booking towards continuous health support.</li> <li>AI is becoming a core part of the product experience, not an isolated feature.</li> <li>The Patient Design organisation is being strengthened and reshaped.</li> <li>The product must work across multiple European countries, languages and healthcare systems.</li> <li>The design foundations for the next chapter are still being built.</li> </ul> <p>This is an opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of <strong>consumer product design, healthcare and AI</strong>, and to define how people will discover, understand and manage their health in the future.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger. At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries. The team To sustain the company's growth, Ledger is looking for a Senior Scala Backend Engineer to join the Cloud Wallet team . This team builds and operates the backend services that power blockchain account management, transaction processing and on-chain data aggregation across all Ledger wallet surfaces, from Ledger Live to Ledger Enterprise, the custody platform used by financial institutions. Every client transaction goes through these services, and so does every new blockchain Ledger supports. We believe in the power of functional programming to build robust and scalable platforms. We take time to share, challenge, and grow together through bi-weekly knowledge-sharing sessions, meetups, conferences, and open source contributions. What you’ll be doing Design, build and operate the Scala services that connect Ledger wallets and the Ledger Enterprise platform to blockchain backends: account creation, operation history, transaction crafting, broadcast and lifecycle tracking. Lead new blockchain integrations end to end, from the integration design (ADR) to production, across account-based, UTXO and privacy-preserving chains. Own production quality on your scope: SLIs and SLOs, observability, distributed tracing. Take part in the firefighting rotation and drive incidents to resolution, including those raised by institutional clients. Define clear contracts with the Coin Integration and Ledger Enterprise teams, for example where UTXO selection lives or how transaction states are exposed to consumers. Write and review ADRs, challenge designs, and raise the bar on code quality, testing (including end-to-end on testnets) and technical debt management. Work in an AI-native way: use coding agents daily, write the specifications, constraints and verification that let them deliver safely, and contribute to the team's AI tooling. Mentor other engineers and share your knowledge across the Backend Blockchain community. You will collaborate cross-functionally with: The Coin Integration team for coin modules and new blockchain integrations. The Ledger Enterprise team, main consumer of the team's services for institutional custody. The Ledger Wallet, Ledger Button and Wallet XP teams as consumers of the team's backend APIs. The Blockchain platform team for data model alignment, indexing and event streaming. The Infrastructure and SRE teams for deployment, reliability and scalability. The Security team (Donjon) for vulnerability analysis and remediation. The Product team for roadmap prioritization and customer-driven requirements. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h4><strong>About the Deal Desk Team</strong></h4> <p>The Deal Desk team is a critical component of the Finance function, serving as a trusted advisor to critical internal stakeholders as deal architect working on structuring, negotiating, approving and closing large complex commitment deals while balancing margin preservation, compliance, and velocity. We are committed to building a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk that leverages predictive analytics and automated workflows to optimize pricing in real-time and automate routine approvals, allowing for deeper strategic focus.</p> <p><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>As a Deal Desk Manager, you will be the architect of our AI-driven deal desk, transitioning our sales process from manual workflows to an intelligent, automated engine that spans from initial scoping to final execution. By leveraging agentic workflows and automated data layers, the focus shifts to high-judgment architecture for non-standard enterprise deals. The objective is to serve as a high-influence "Sales Co-pilot," using AI-driven insights to maximize deal velocity and Long-Term Value (LTV) while relentlessly reducing friction through iterative process automation.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Orchestrate Strategic Deal Architecture: Lead the structuring and execution of non-standard, high-value enterprise deals, providing high-judgment guidance that balances competitive differentiation with long-term business health. Drive consensus across internal stakeholders (Legal, Finance, Revenue Recognition, Compliance and Product) to negotiate viable compromises on non-standard commercial, financial, and legal terms while safeguarding corporate margin thresholds and risk tolerance.</li> <li>Champion AI, Curate and Tune AI Agents for Automation Integration: Manage the enterprise deal approval ecosystem by tuning automated agents and models to ensure compliance and accuracy at scale. Champion the integration of LLMs and generative AI tools to automate deal desk workflows, significantly reducing deal cycle times. Identify bottlenecks and implement AI-powered productivity solutions.</li> <li>Drive Process Iteration: Partner with cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance, Product) to build, streamline, and automate deal desk processes, architecting autonomous approval workflows and focusing on reducing field friction through relentless automation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Specifications & Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Minimum 8+ years of Deal Desk, FP&A, Revenue Operations, or similar experience with a proven track record supporting large-scale enterprise sales motions; 3+ years of direct deal desk experience (deal analysis, deal governance and customer negotiation) preferred</li> <li><strong>Financial & Sales Acumen: </strong>Solid understanding of SaaS metrics, pricing models, and financial concepts like ARR, Gross Margin, churn, and profitability. Experience with revenue recognition principles (e.g., ASC 606) is highly desirable. Experience selling software is a bonus</li> <li><strong>Contract & Pricing Knowledge: </strong>Experience drafting and interpreting commercial contracts, with a focus on terms that impact revenue recognition and financial risk. Ability to analyze and recommend the best course of action for complex pricing and licensing situations</li> <li><strong>Data & AI Literacy: </strong>Proficiency in leveraging agentic workflows and prompt engineering to scale influence, extract insights from large datasets, and automate repetitive operational tasks and internal documentation. Ability to understand and audit automated pricing models to ensure alignment with long-term company goals.Relentless focus on iterative automation and translating complex business policies into streamlined, automated logic</li> <li><strong>Strategic Influence & Negotiation: </strong>Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, internal cross-functional negotiations and make high-judgment decisions in fast-paced environments. Partner directly with Sales Management and Account Executives  during external customer negotiations, equipping them with counter-proposal options or directly engaging in client commercial discussions to structure win-win enterprise agreements</li> <li><strong>Communication: </strong>Serve as the single point of contact between Sales, Finance, Revenue Recognition (ASC 606), Legal, and Product Management on advising deal constructing and managing deal escalation. Skilled in commercial negotiation strategy, advising Sales on customer-facing concessions, and directly engaging in external negotiations with customer procurement/legal teams to drive deal closure. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, capable of explaining complex deal structures and financial data to both technical and executive stakeholders</li> <li>Language Preference: Additional proficiency in Mandarin or Japanese would be beneficial for engaging with customers and stakeholders in relevant APJC markets.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Unsere Mission: Betriebliche Vorsorge digital und verständlich, effizient und für jeden zugänglich zu machen. Seit 2007 arbeiten wir stetig daran, die Digitalisierung der Versicherungsbranche voranzutreiben. Wir bei Xempus sind davon überzeugt, dass wir alle gemeinsam etwas bewirken können – egal von wo! Ob von einem unserer Büros oder von zu Hause ­– Komm zu uns und lass uns gemeinsam eine sicherere Zukunft für alle schaffen! Du entwickelst unsere Engineering-Prozesse, Wissensmanagement-Formate und Standards kontinuierlich weiter. Du unterstützt die langfristige Weiterentwicklung und Modernisierung unserer Plattform – mit Blick auf Stabilität, Performance, Wartbarkeit und Skalierbarkeit. Du kennst dich mit Datenbanken, APIs und dem gesamten Softwareentwicklungsprozess aus – von der technischen Konzeption über die Umsetzung bis zum Betrieb. Du hast Erfahrung in der fachlichen und disziplinarischen Führung sowie im Coaching und in der Weiterentwicklung von Software Engineers. Du kommunizierst sicher mit technischen und nicht-technischen Ansprechpartnern und agierst souverän zwischen Engineering, Product, Management und externen Partnern. title: Director Product (m/w/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Unsere Produkte sind der Grund, warum Kund:innen bei uns kaufen und immer wieder zurückkommen. Als Director Product (m/w/d) verantwortest du alles, was dahintersteht, für alle Marken der SNOCKS Group: von der ersten Produktidee über Sourcing und Produktion bis zur Lieferung ins Lager. Product Development, Sourcing und Supply Chain aber auch Quality Management und ESG sind dein Kern, und genau dort bist du strategisch wie operativ tief drin. Du setzt die Richtung, führst die Heads und ihre Teams und hältst die Fäden über alle Abteilungen hinweg zusammen. Wenn es darauf ankommt, sitzt du selbst mit am Tisch der Supplier. Kurz: Du bist die Person, die unser Produkt-Business nach vorne bringt, mit Weitblick und mit beiden Händen im Tagesgeschäft. Deine Aufgaben Produktstrategie : Du entwickelst mit den PD-Heads und in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CEO Rehan die Produkt- und Sortimentsstrategie für unsere Marken, bewertest neue Kategorien und übersetzt alles in eine klare Roadmap. Product Development: Du steuerst die Entwicklung neuer Produkte und Launches, challengst Ideen und sorgst dafür, dass aus guten Konzepten erfolgreiche Produkte werden. Sourcing & Supplier Management : Du verantwortest unsere Supplier-Landschaft, vor allem in China und Pakistan, baust eigene, belastbare Beziehungen auf und verhandelst Preise, Qualität und Timings gemeinsam mit unserem Supply Chain Team. Den Aufbau von Direct Sourcing treibst du strategisch voran. Supply Chain: Du sorgst für eine stabile, effiziente Lieferkette von der Bestellung bis zur Ware im Lager und erkennst Engpässe, bevor sie zum Problem werden. Performance & Zahlen: Du hast die Performance der Brands und neuer Launches im Blick, gehst in Product Deep Dives und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten. Leadership : Du führst die Heads sowie die Teams aus Product Development, Supply Chain, Quality Management und ESG mit Empathie, klaren Zielen und ehrlichem Feedback. Bei dir laufen alle Fäden zusammen und du entwickelst die Menschen weiter. Krisen- & Konfliktmanagement: Wenn es intern oder bei Suppliern brennt, bleibst du ruhig, deeskalierst und findest Lösungen. Prozesse & Workflows: Du baust Strukturen, die wirklich funktionieren, und machst unseren Produktbereich skalierbar. Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du bist Schnittstelle zu fast allen Bereichen der Gruppe, von Brand und E-Commerce über Marketplace bis Finance, und bist Sparringspartner:in für Rehan. Dein Profil Studium : Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Textilmanagement oder ein vergleichbarer Hintergrund. Noch wichtiger ist uns, was du in deiner Laufbahn schon aufgebaut und bewegt hast. Erfahrung : Mindestens 8 Jahre fundierte Erfahrung in Product Development, Sourcing und Supply Chain, idealerweise in der Textilbranche. Leadership-Erfahrung : Du hast bereits Teams und Führungskräfte geführt und tust das mit Empathie, Klarheit und echtem Interesse an den Menschen. Product Development : Du bringst fundiertes Know-how in der Produktentwicklung mit, von der Idee über Sampling bis zur Serienreife, und erkennst, was ein Produkt erfolgreich macht. Sourcing & Supply Chain : Du hast Supplier-Landschaften bereits aktiv gesteuert, kennst Produktions- und Lieferprozesse im Detail und kannst Kosten, Qualität und Timings fachlich challengen. QM & Sustainability : Du hast ein solides Grundverständnis für Qualitätsmanagement und Nachhaltigkeit. Strategie & Hands-on : Du denkst strategisch, arbeitest aber genauso gern operativ mit, vor allem in der Supplier-Kommunikation. Ins kalte Wasser zu springen schreckt dich nicht ab. Verhandlungsstärke : Du verhandelst souverän und selbstbewusst, auch dann, wenn es ungemütlich wird. Sourcing-Netzwerk : Ein bestehendes Netzwerk im Direct Sourcing oder Erfahrung im Aufbau davon ist ein dickes Plus. Erfahrung mit Produktion in China und Pakistan ebenso. Mindset : Du sagst klar deine Meinung, übernimmst Ownership wie für dein eigenes Business und gehst mit viel Freiraum verantwortungsvoll um. Reisebereitschaft & Präsenz : Du bist regelmäßig vor Ort in Mannheim und Berlin und reist gern zu unseren Suppliern, bei Bedarf auch spontan. Sprachen : Sehr sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Warum wir? Dich erwartet ein modernes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Du-Kultur von Tag eins. Wir glauben an flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsmethoden. Unsere Teams bestehen aus motivierten Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen. Goodies für dich: Von Jobrad-Leasing über Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket bis hin zu betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (Arbeitgeberzuschuss 50%) - bei uns profitierst du von vielen Extras. On top gibt’s Mitarbeitenden-Rabatt in unserem Snocks Coffee und einen steuerfreien Sachbezug (50€ / Monat), den du flexibel für deinen Wocheneinkauf oder z.B. eine Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club einsetzen kannst. Arbeiten, wie’s zu dir passt : Du arbeitest, wo du am produktivsten bist. Remote ist Standard, aber wenn du doch mal Lust hast, ins Büro nach Mannheim, Hamburg oder Berlin zu kommen, gibt’s dafür ein Monatsbudget. Echte Flexibilität : Ob Workation mit Freund:innen oder Kolleg:innen, morgendliches Yoga oder eine Sport-Session mittags – bei uns kannst du Arbeit und Privatleben easy miteinander verbinden. Onboarding : Du startest nicht mit leeren Händen, sondern bekommst top Hardware, alles was du zum Arbeiten brauchst, und kannst dir im Welcome Shop coole Produkte von unseren Partnern & Friends aussuchen. Du weißt nicht weiter? Wir unterstützen dich mit unseren Weiterbildungsangeboten und individuellen Development Budgets! Und wenns nicht ums Berufliche geht, kannst du deinen Zugang zur Gesundheitsplattform nilo.health nutzen, um dir den Support zu holen, den du brauchst. description: Deine Aufgaben Du glaubst, dass AI-generierte Bilder nicht nach AI aussehen sollten? Perfekt. title: Solution Consultant Intern
description: About Mirakl: Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy. Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus). With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique. Our 5 values guide how we collaborate: 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success Solution Consultant Intern — Mirakl Connect 📍 Paris | 🗓 January – June 2027 (6 months) 1. The Team You'll Join You'll be part of our EMEA Solution Consulting team led by Jonathan D'Elissagaray, Director of Solution Consulting . The team consists of two Solution Consultants focused on Mirakl Connect, working alongside four Platform Consultants covering B2B customers across Southern Europe and the Middle East. Together, you'll be helping sellers successfully onboard and grow through the Mirakl Connect ecosystem. About Mirakl Connect Mirakl Connect is Mirakl's ecosystem platform, connecting marketplace operators and sellers to simplify partnerships, onboarding, and growth. Trusted by leading brands such as Macy's and Lacoste , Mirakl Connect helps sellers discover new marketplace opportunities while enabling marketplace teams to efficiently onboard and manage their seller ecosystem at scale. 2. Your Impact Support and progressively take ownership of end-to-end seller onboarding on Mirakl Connect, starting with simpler cases and building towards greater autonomy. Guide sellers through key onboarding steps and deliver clear enablement sessions tailored to audiences with varying levels of technical knowledge. Develop expertise in Catalog Transformer — Mirakl's AI-based catalogue management product — and support sellers in troubleshooting and optimising their catalogues. Contribute to scaling onboarding by creating and improving documentation, guides, and internal content, and by identifying opportunities for process and reporting automation. Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, and Data Science/AI teams, capturing feedback from onboarding activities to continuously improve the seller experience. 3. What You'll Bring to the Role Experience: Currently enrolled in a Master's programme (M1 or M2) at a business school, engineering school, or equivalent institution, available for a six-month internship from January 2027 At least one previous internship or corporate experience, ideally in an enterprise environment Demonstrated interest in technology, SaaS platforms, or digital products Familiarity with APIs, data, or automation tools is a plus but not required Skills: Autonomous and solution-oriented, with solid project management skills and the ability to see tasks through from start to finish Strong communication and teaching skills, able to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences Curious and proactive, with a genuine interest in AI and a willingness to use it practically, including for troubleshooting AI-based products Organised and able to manage multiple priorities effectively in a fast-paced environment Comfortable working in English across an international, cross-functional team 4. Tools Used Mirakl Connect Salesforce Gong Google Workspace (Sheets, Slides, Drive) Confluence Dust Catalog Transformer 5. Languages English: Professional proficiency required French: Professional proficiency is a plus 6. Compensation, Perks & Benefits Pay Range: €1,200 – €1,400 per month (depending on profile and study level) Perks & Benefits: A workplace that promotes well-being and balance: breakfasts, yoga and sports classes, after-work drinks, and game nights A tailor-made onboarding experience designed to help you hit the ground running A unique opportunity to join a fast-growing French unicorn and collaborate with international teams Access to CSE discounts (ticketing, cultural activities, and more) Gymlib pass to support your well-being Modern offices in the heart of Paris Swile meal vouchers 50% coverage of transportation costs (Navigo pass, bike, and more) 7. Our Hiring Process We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match. Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter, followed by an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma , Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days , otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application. 30-minute Talent Acquisition interview with Heather Decoudun Interview with Jonathan D'Elissagaray , Director of Solution Consulting Values interview with a trained Mirakl interviewer We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews . Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

systems.</li> <li>Work across JavaScript, TypeScript, Rust, and C++.</li> <li>Help drive the continued evolution of the system.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience writing systems software.</li> <li>Operational mindset with experience owning code in production.</li> <li>Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and system design.</li> platforms, especially serverless architectures.</li> <li>Experience as a technical leader or team lead, driving engineering decisions.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Experience working on database internals, especially SQLite.</li> <li>Deep understanding of web technologies such as browsers, HTTP, JavaScript, and WebAssembly.</li> <li>Background in low-latency, real-time environments such as game streaming, high-frequency trading, or payment systems.</li> <li>Experience debugging, optimizing, and identifying failure modes in large-scale Linux-based distributed systems.</li> </ul>
